claims.zh_tw: SQ Associations 讓主機在建立 I/O Submission Queue 時，提供該 SQ 對應的 NVM Set，作為控制器在 Predictable Latency Mode 下改善效能的提示。這是選用能力；Predictable Latency Mode 不依賴主機一定使用 SQ Associations。
claims.en: SQ Associations lets a host associate an I/O Submission Queue with an NVM Set at queue creation, providing a hint for improved performance with Predictable Latency Mode. It is optional; Predictable Latency Mode does not depend on using SQ Associations.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 把佇列用途告訴控制器
claims.heading_en: Tell the controller which set a queue serves
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.28, printed pages 732-733, PDF pages 758-759

claims.zh_tw: 支援 SQ Associations 的控制器必須在 CTRATT 同時宣告 SQA、NVM Sets 與 Predictable Latency Mode 支援。這些支援位元不表示每個 Set 目前都已啟用模式，也不表示目前處於可提供確定性延遲的視窗。
claims.en: A controller supporting SQ Associations must advertise SQA, NVM Sets and Predictable Latency Mode in CTRATT. These support bits do not mean that every set has the mode enabled or is currently in a deterministic window.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 支援能力、模式狀態與工作視窗
claims.heading_en: Separate support, mode state and operating windows
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.28, printed pages 732-733, PDF pages 758-759

claims.zh_tw: Predictable Latency Mode 有 DTWIN／NDWIN；DTWIN 的確定性依賴操作限制與當時狀態，SQ 提示不會取消這些條件。
claims.en: Predictable Latency Mode has DTWIN/NDWIN; determinism depends on operating rules and current state, which the SQ hint does not remove.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 支援能力、模式狀態與工作視窗
claims.heading_en: Separate support, mode state and operating windows
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.21, printed pages 682-683, PDF pages 708-709

claims.zh_tw: 主機需要兩份資訊：NVM Set List 說明控制器可存取哪些 Set，Identify Namespace 則說明指定 namespace 屬於哪個 Set。清單位置、NVM Set Identifier 與 NSID 是不同數值，不能用同一個編號代替。
claims.en: The host needs two kinds of information: the NVM Set List identifies accessible sets, while Identify Namespace identifies the set containing a namespace. List position, NVM Set Identifier and NSID are different values.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 先建立 namespace 到 Set 的對照
claims.heading_en: Map namespaces to sets before routing commands
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.4, printed pages 388-389, PDF pages 414-415

claims.zh_tw: CNS=08h 對 目前可存取的 NSID 回 namespace 結構；NVMSETID 位於 bytes 11:10。inactive NSID 回全零資料，不能當有效歸屬。
claims.en: CNS=08h returns the namespace structure for an active NSID, with NVMSETID at bytes 11:10. An inactive NSID returns zeros rather than a valid membership mapping.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 先建立 namespace 到 Set 的對照
claims.heading_en: Map namespaces to sets before routing commands
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.8, printed pages 390,393, PDF pages 416,419

claims.zh_tw: Create I/O Submission Queue 的 CDW12.NVMSETID 建立 SQ 與 Set 的關聯；CDW11.CQID 則指定完成結果送往哪個 CQ。兩個欄位用途不同。NVMSETID=0 或不支援 SQA 時不建立特定 Set 關聯；SQA 支援時指定清單外的非零 Set，命令必須以 Invalid Field in Command 中止。
claims.en: Create I/O Submission Queue uses CDW12.NVMSETID for the set association and CDW11.CQID for the destination completion queue. NVMSETID=0 or unsupported SQA means no specific set association. With SQA supported, a nonzero identifier absent from the set list must cause Invalid Field in Command.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 建立 SQ 時，同時指定 Set 與完成佇列
claims.heading_en: Select both the set and completion queue when creating an SQ
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.3.2, printed pages 529-531, PDF pages 555-557

claims.zh_tw: PCIe 的多個 SQ 可以使用同一個 CQ；共用完成佇列不會取代各 SQ 的 Set 關聯。
claims.en: Multiple PCIe SQs may share a CQ; the shared completion destination does not replace their individual set associations.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 建立 SQ 時，同時指定 Set 與完成佇列
claims.heading_en: Select both the set and completion queue when creating an SQ
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.3, 文件頁 88, PDF 頁 114
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.3, printed pages 88, PDF pages 114

claims.zh_tw: 要取得 SQ Associations 的效益，主機必須把每個 I/O SQ 關聯到某個 NVM Set，並只把命令送入與該命令 NSID 所屬 Set 相符的 SQ。不遵守操作規則可能影響 Predictable Latency；這不是一個由本節定義的強制拒絕其他 Set 命令的存取保護機制。
claims.en: To obtain the benefits of SQ Associations, the host must associate each I/O submission queue with an NVM Set and send commands only to queues matching the set containing the command’s NSID. Violating the operating rules may affect Predictable Latency; this section does not define mandatory access-control rejection of mismatched commands.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 讓每筆 I/O 的 Set 與 SQ 關聯一致
claims.heading_en: Keep each I/O’s set consistent with its SQ association
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.28, 文件頁 733, PDF 頁 759
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.28, printed pages 733, PDF pages 759

claims.zh_tw: 先讀 namespace 的包含關係，才知道 SQ 應該服務哪一個 Set。
claims.en: Figure 67, "NVM Sets and Associated Namespaces": Namespace containment determines the set an SQ should serve; completion destinations do not change storage membership.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.2.2, Figure 67, 文件頁 81, PDF 頁 107
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.2.2, Figure 67, printed pages 81, PDF pages 107

claims.zh_tw: CDW10 的 CNS 選擇要問哪個問題，CNTID 不是 namespace 的編號。
claims.en: Figure 333, "Identify – Command Dword 10": CNS in CDW10 chooses the question; CNTID is not a namespace identifier.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14, Figure 333, 文件頁 337, PDF 頁 363
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14, Figure 333, printed pages 337, PDF pages 363

claims.zh_tw: CDW11 低 16 bits 的意思由 CNS 決定，不是每次 Identify 都在選 Set。
claims.en: Figure 334, "Identify – Command Dword 11": CDW11’s low 16 bits depend on CNS; they are not a set selector for every Identify query.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14, Figure 334, 文件頁 337, PDF 頁 363
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14, Figure 334, printed pages 337, PDF pages 363

claims.zh_tw: 先用 CNS 列選回覆結構，再用 Y／N 判斷 NSID、CNTID、CSI 是否參與這次查詢。
claims.en: Figure 336, "Identify – CNS Values": Choose the response using the CNS row, then read Y/N for whether each selector is used.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14, Figure 336, 文件頁 338-339, PDF 頁 364-365
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14, Figure 336, printed pages 338-339, PDF pages 364-365

claims.zh_tw: CTRATT 的三個 bit 回答支援能力，沒有回報 SQ 關聯清單或目前工作視窗。
claims.en: Figure 338, "Identify – Identify Controller Data Structure, I/O Command Set Independent": The three CTRATT bits report support, not a list of queue associations or the current window.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.1, Figure 338, printed pages 344-346, PDF pages 370-372

claims.zh_tw: 清單的起點是 Set 識別值下限，而且包含等於該值的 entry。
claims.en: Figure 343, "Command Dword 11 - CNS Specific Identifier": The starting identifier is an inclusive lower bound, not an entry index or page number.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.4, Figure 343, 文件頁 388, PDF 頁 414
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.4, Figure 343, printed pages 388, PDF pages 414

claims.zh_tw: NUMENT 是直接筆數，entry 位置則由固定 header 與 128-byte 步距計算。
claims.en: Figure 344, "NVM Set List": NUMENT is a direct count; record locations use a 128-byte header and 128-byte stride.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.4, Figure 344, 文件頁 389, PDF 頁 415
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.4, Figure 344, printed pages 389, PDF pages 415

claims.zh_tw: 同一筆 entry 同時有識別值、效能參考與儲存容量，必須分開使用。
claims.en: Figure 345, "NVM Set Attributes Entry": One entry combines identity, performance references and storage capacity; the values have different uses and units.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.4, Figure 345, 文件頁 389, PDF 頁 415
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.4, Figure 345, printed pages 389, PDF pages 415

claims.zh_tw: 查特定 NSID 的 NVMSETID，才能把 I/O 對象接到正確的 Set。
claims.en: Figure 346, "I/O Command Set Independent Identify Namespace Data Structure": NVMSETID for a specific active NSID supplies membership; an all-namespaces capability query does not.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.8, Figure 346, printed pages 390,393, PDF pages 416,419

claims.zh_tw: PRP1 的內容由 PC 決定，描述的是 SQ 記憶體，不是 namespace 資料位置。
claims.en: Figure 575, "Create I/O Submission Queue – PRP Entry 1": PC determines whether PRP1 names contiguous queue memory or a PRP List; neither is a namespace address.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.3.2, Figure 575, 文件頁 529, PDF 頁 555
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.3.2, Figure 575, printed pages 529, PDF pages 555

claims.zh_tw: QSIZE 選數量、QID 選名稱，64 筆 SQ3 要編成 003F0003h。
claims.en: Figure 576, "Create I/O Submission Queue – Command Dword 10": QSIZE encodes count minus one, while QID names the queue: 003F0003h creates a 64-entry SQ3.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.3.2, Figure 576, 文件頁 529, PDF 頁 555
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.3.2, Figure 576, printed pages 529, PDF pages 555

claims.zh_tw: CQID 決定後續 I/O 的完成去處；PC 與 QPRIO 分別影響記憶體描述與仲裁。
claims.en: Figure 577, "Create I/O Submission Queue – Command Dword 11": CQID selects the completion destination; PC describes memory and QPRIO matters only under its specified arbitration mechanism.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.3.2, Figure 577, 文件頁 529-530, PDF 頁 555-556
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.3.2, Figure 577, printed pages 529-530, PDF pages 555-556

claims.zh_tw: NVMSETID 在建立 SQ 時提供 Set 關聯，0 在這個命令明確表示沒有特定關聯。
claims.en: Figure 578, "Create I/O Submission Queue – Command Dword 12": NVMSETID supplies the set association at creation; zero explicitly means no specific association in this command.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.3.2, Figure 578, 文件頁 530, PDF 頁 556
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.3.2, Figure 578, printed pages 530, PDF pages 556

claims.zh_tw: 建立命令的錯誤值要搭配錯誤類別與觸發欄位，不能當作後續 I/O 的分流檢查表。
claims.en: Figure 579, "Create I/O Submission Queue – Command Specific Status Values": Creation status values must be read with their status category and triggering fields; they do not specify later I/O routing validation.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.3.2, Figure 579, 文件頁 530-531, PDF 頁 556-557
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.3.2, Figure 579, printed pages 530-531, PDF pages 556-557

claims.zh_tw: DTWIN 與 NDWIN 表示同一 Set 沿時間經過的不同工作視窗，不是兩個 Set。
claims.en: Figure 751, "Deterministic and Non-Deterministic Windows": DTWIN and NDWIN are successive operating windows of a set, not two different sets or fixed-duration slots.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.21, Figure 751, 文件頁 682-683, PDF 頁 708-709
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.21, Figure 751, printed pages 682-683, PDF pages 708-709

claims.zh_tw: Read Recovery Level（RRL）在讀取完成時間與錯誤復原投入之間提供取捨。支援此功能時，Level 4 是必備的預設等級，Level 15 是必備的 Fast Fail；Level 0 若有支援，提供最多復原。等級越高，復原量越少；與 I/O 命令 LR 的互動由實作決定。
claims.en: Read Recovery Level (RRL) balances read completion time against recovery effort. When the feature is supported, level 4 is the mandatory default and level 15 is mandatory Fast Fail. Optional level 0 provides maximum recovery. Higher levels provide less recovery; interaction with an I/O command’s LR field is implementation-specific.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 讀取遇到困難時，要花多少力氣復原？
claims.heading_en: How much recovery should a difficult read receive?
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.23, printed pages 689-690, PDF pages 715-716

claims.zh_tw: 有 NVM Sets 時，FID 12h 以 NVM Set 為範圍，選中的集合共用一份 RRL。沒有 NVM Sets 時，範圍改為整個 NVM subsystem，所有 namespace 使用同一等級。改變 RRL 不會改變 namespace 中已有的資料。
claims.en: With NVM Sets, FID 12h has NVM Set scope with one RRL for the selected set. Without NVM Sets, the feature has NVM subsystem scope and all namespaces use one level. Changing RRL does not change their stored data.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 一個設定，會影響哪些儲存空間？
claims.heading_en: Which storage spaces share one setting?
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.12, printed pages 473, PDF pages 499

claims.zh_tw: Identify Controller 的 CTRATT.RRLVLS 表示是否支援功能，RRLS 的 16 個 bits 分別表示各等級是否支援。CTRATT.NSETS 決定使用 Set 或 subsystem 範圍；ONCS.SSFS 則決定能否使用非零 SEL 與 SV。這些能力不能互相替代。
claims.en: Identify Controller reports feature support in CTRATT.RRLVLS and individual levels in the 16-bit RRLS bitmap. CTRATT.NSETS selects set versus subsystem scope. ONCS.SSFS controls support for nonzero SEL and SV. These capabilities answer different questions.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 讀懂支援位元，才知道哪些值能選
claims.heading_en: Read capability bits before choosing a level
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.1, printed pages 344-347,371-372, PDF pages 370-373,397-398

claims.zh_tw: Set Features 用 FID 12h 選 Read Recovery Level Config，CDW11 的低 16 bits 放 NVMSETID，CDW12 的低 4 bits 放 RRL。這個 Feature 不使用資料 buffer；NVM Set 或 subsystem 範圍的 NSID 應為 0。
claims.en: Set Features selects Read Recovery Level Config with FID 12h. CDW11 bits 15:0 carry NVMSETID; CDW12 bits 3:0 carry RRL. No data buffer is used, and NSID should be zero for the NVM Set or subsystem scope.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 把「哪個集合、哪個等級」組成設定命令
claims.heading_en: Encode the target set and requested level
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.12, printed pages 473, PDF pages 499

claims.zh_tw: 成功的 Get Features 在 SEL≠3 時，以 CQE DW0 回傳 Figure 485 格式的 RRL。SEL=3 則改回 Supported Capabilities：CHANG、NSSPEC、SVBL。相同 DW0 數值可能有完全不同的意思；RRLS 等級清單仍應從 Identify Controller 取得。
claims.en: Successful Get Features with SEL other than 3 returns RRL in CQE DW0 using Figure 485. SEL=3 instead returns Supported Capabilities: CHANG, NSSPEC and SVBL. The same DW0 value can have entirely different meanings; the level bitmap remains in Identify Controller.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 讀回時先看 SEL，才知道 DW0 在回答什麼
claims.heading_en: Interpret returned DW0 according to SEL
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.12, printed pages 473, PDF pages 499

claims.zh_tw: 已提交而尚在執行的命令，可能套用或不套用剛改好的 Feature。Set Features 成功完成後才提交的命令，必須使用新設定。若希望明確區隔兩批讀取，主機宜先讓原有命令完成，再改設定。
claims.en: Commands already submitted may or may not use a newly changed feature value. Commands submitted after successful Set Features completion must use the new settings. To separate two read batches clearly, the host should let outstanding commands complete before changing the feature.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 以成功完成為界，區分舊命令與新命令
claims.heading_en: Use successful completion as the settings boundary
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1, 文件頁 459, PDF 頁 485
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1, printed pages 459, PDF pages 485

claims.zh_tw: Figure 466 把 FID 12h 的持續性列為 Yes，但該欄只適用於不可保存的 Feature。若本 Feature 可保存，應依 current／saved 與重設範圍判斷：整個 subsystem 範圍的重設按 Figure 126，局部範圍按 Figure 127。例如多控制器的 subsystem 只重設一個控制器，Set／subsystem 的共用目前值維持不變；符合全體條件的重設則回到 saved，沒有 saved 才回 default。
claims.en: Figure 466 lists persistence as Yes for FID 12h, but that column applies only to non-saveable features. If the feature is saveable, distinguish current from saved and use the reset scope: Figure 126 for whole-subsystem scope, Figure 127 for a subset. Resetting one controller in a multi-controller subsystem retains the shared current value. An applicable whole-subsystem reset instead restores saved, or default if no saved value exists.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 重設後保留什麼，要分可保存性與重設範圍
claims.heading_en: Persistence depends on saveability and reset scope
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.4, printed pages 167-169, PDF pages 193-195

claims.zh_tw: 在 NVM Set 內建立的 namespace 繼承該 Set 的 RRL；不支援 NVM Sets 時，所有 namespace 使用同一 RRL。
claims.en: A namespace created in an NVM Set inherits that set’s RRL; without NVM Sets, all namespaces use one RRL.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 在 NVM Set 內建立的 namespace 繼承該 Set 的 RRL；不支援 NVM Sets 時，所有 namespace 使用同一 RRL。
claims.heading_en: A namespace created in an NVM Set inherits that set’s RRL; without NVM Sets, all namespaces use one RRL.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.23, 文件頁 689, PDF 頁 715
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.23, printed pages 689, PDF pages 715

claims.zh_tw: NVM Set 與 subsystem 範圍的 Feature，NSID 應為 0；非零值使 Get／Set Features 被中止，不能用來縮小成單一 namespace。
claims.en: For an NVM Set or subsystem-scoped feature, NSID should be zero; nonzero values cause Get/Set Features to be aborted rather than narrowing the scope to a namespace.
claims.heading_zh_tw: NVM Set 與 subsystem 範圍的 Feature，NSID 應為 0；非零值使 Get／Set Features 被中止，不能用來縮小成單一 namespace。
claims.heading_en: For an NVM Set or subsystem-scoped feature, NSID should be zero; nonzero values cause Get/Set Features to be aborted rather than narrowing the scope to a namespace.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.4, 文件頁 169, PDF 頁 195
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.4, printed pages 169, PDF pages 195

claims.zh_tw: FID 12h 不使用資料 buffer；Set 的 CDW10 帶 FID 與 SV。未使用的命令專用欄位保留，不可保存時要求 SV=1 會以 Feature Identifier Not Saveable 中止。
claims.en: FID 12h uses no data buffer. Set CDW10 carries FID and SV; unused command-specific fields are reserved, and SV=1 for a non-saveable feature causes Feature Identifier Not Saveable.
claims.heading_zh_tw: FID 12h 不使用資料 buffer；Set 的 CDW10 帶 FID 與 SV。未使用的命令專用欄位保留，不可保存時要求 SV=1 會以 Feature Identifier Not Saveable 中止。
claims.heading_en: FID 12h uses no data buffer. Set CDW10 carries FID and SV; unused command-specific fields are reserved, and SV=1 for a non-saveable feature causes Feature Identifier Not Saveable.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30, printed pages 456-459, PDF pages 482-485

claims.zh_tw: SEL 的 0、1、2、3 分別選目前、預設、已保存與能力。沒有可用的 saved 值時，saved 查詢回 default；能力格式只表示 CHANG、NSSPEC 與 SVBL。
claims.en: SEL 0/1/2/3 selects current/default/saved/capabilities. A saved query returns default when no saved value is available; the capability format reports CHANG, NSSPEC and SVBL.
claims.heading_zh_tw: SEL 的 0、1、2、3 分別選目前、預設、已保存與能力。沒有可用的 saved 值時，saved 查詢回 default；能力格式只表示 CHANG、NSSPEC 與 SVBL。
claims.heading_en: SEL 0/1/2/3 selects current/default/saved/capabilities. A saved query returns default when no saved value is available; the capability format reports CHANG, NSSPEC and SVBL.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12, printed pages 209-212, PDF pages 235-238

claims.zh_tw: 多個主機同時存取非 controller scope 的共享 Feature 值，需要主機間協調；Base 沒有指定協調程序。
claims.en: Concurrent access by multiple hosts to shared features outside controller scope requires host coordination, whose procedure is not specified by Base.

claims.en: NVMSETID is a 16-bit set identifier within the subsystem. Zero is reserved when NVM Sets are supported; otherwise the host clears the field to zero.
claims.heading_zh_tw: NVMSETID 是 subsystem 內的 16-bit Set 識別值；支援 NVM Sets 時 0 為保留，不支援時主機將此欄清為 0。

claims.en: Figure 198, "Get Features – Command Dword 10": SEL chooses current, default, saved or capability information for the same FID.

claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12, Figure 198, printed pages 209-210, PDF pages 235-236

claims.en: Figure 201, "Completion Queue Entry Dword 0 when Select is set to 11b": SEL=3 returns three capability bits, not a level bitmap or the current RRL.

claims.en: Figure 338, "Identify – Identify Controller Data Structure, I/O Command Set Independent": Check the feature bit, the candidate level in RRLS, and support for extended Feature selection separately.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.1, Figure 338, printed pages 344-347,371-372, PDF pages 370-373,397-398

claims.en: Figure 463, "Set Features – Data Pointer": Set Features uses DPTR only when the selected feature requires an attribute data structure.

claims.en: Figure 464, "Set Features – Command Dword 10": FID selects the feature and SV requests saving; SV does not select the affected scope.

claims.en: Figure 466, "Set Features – Feature Identifiers": The Yes in the FID 12h row is conditional on footnote 2: it applies only to a non-saveable feature.

claims.en: Figure 755, "Read Recovery Level Overview": Increasing levels mean decreasing recovery; M/O denotes support requirements, not performance scores.

claims.zh_tw: Command and Feature Lockdown 讓主機限制特定管理命令，或 Set Features 對某個 FID 的設定操作。限制同時有操作種類、接收介面與控制器範圍；LID 14h 用來查可禁止項目與目前禁止狀態，Lockdown 命令用來改變它們。
claims.en: Command and Feature Lockdown restricts selected management commands or Set Features operations targeting a particular FID. Each restriction has an operation class, incoming interface and controller scope. LID 14h reports what can be prohibited and what is currently prohibited; Lockdown changes that state.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 先理解：限制的是哪個操作從哪裡進來
claims.heading_en: Start with the operation and its incoming interface
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.5, printed pages 597-599, PDF pages 623-625

claims.zh_tw: Identify Controller 的 OACS.CFLS 表示基本 Lockdown 能力，CCFLS 表示可選控制器的擴充能力。CFLS=1 保證 CSEL=0 與 LID 14h；CCFLS=1 還要求 CSEL=1、2 與增強版 Log。每個 OFI 能否被禁止仍需查清單。
claims.en: OACS.CFLS advertises basic Lockdown support, while CCFLS advertises controller-scoped support. CFLS requires CSEL=0 and LID 14h; CCFLS additionally requires CSEL=1/2 and the enhanced log. The list still determines whether an individual OFI is prohibitable.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 先查支援層級，再查可禁止項目
claims.heading_en: Check capability level before choosing an item
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.5, 文件頁 599, PDF 頁 625
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.5, printed pages 599, PDF pages 625

claims.zh_tw: IFC 選命令接收介面：00b 為 Admin Submission Queue，01b 為該 Queue 加 Management Endpoint，10b 為 Management Endpoint。CSEL 選全部控制器、單一控制器或某 primary 的 secondary controllers，CSS 再提供所需控制器編號。
claims.en: IFC selects the incoming interface: 00b is the Admin Submission Queue, 01b adds the Management Endpoint, and 10b is the Management Endpoint only. CSEL selects all controllers, one controller, or a primary controller’s secondaries; CSS supplies the required controller identifier.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 介面與控制器是兩個獨立選擇
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.16, printed pages 406-407, PDF pages 432-433

claims.zh_tw: LID 14h 的 SCP 選項目種類，CNTTS=00b 查可禁止、01b 查 Admin Queue 目前禁止、10b 查 Management Endpoint 目前禁止。ELPF=0 使用一般格式；ELPF=1 使用增強格式，並以 LSI.CNTLID 選控制器，FFFFh 查所有控制器。
claims.en: For LID 14h, SCP selects the item class; CNTTS=00b requests prohibitable items, 01b current Admin Queue prohibitions, and 10b current Management Endpoint prohibitions. ELPF selects the basic or enhanced format. Enhanced requests use LSI.CNTLID, with FFFFh selecting all controllers.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 把 LID 14h 的查詢問題寫完整
claims.heading_en: Ask a precise question with LID 14h
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.20, printed pages 279-280, PDF pages 305-306

claims.zh_tw: 一般 Log 固定 512 bytes，CFILA 回報查詢種類，LNGTH 直接表示後方代碼清單的 byte 數，清單從 byte 4 開始並由小到大排列。對全體控制器的可禁止項目與 Admin Queue 目前禁止項目，不能把一般清單當成任何一台控制器的聯集。
claims.en: The basic log is 512 bytes. CFILA identifies the query meaning, LNGTH directly counts bytes in the ascending code list starting at byte 4. Its all-controller prohibitable and Admin Queue prohibited lists must not be mistaken for a union of items reported by any controller.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 一般格式：一串代碼代表全體共同的項目
claims.heading_en: Basic format: a compact list with subsystem-wide meaning
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.20, printed pages 281, PDF pages 307

claims.zh_tw: 增強 Log 用 16-byte header 說明版本、查詢種類、CNTLID、SZE、NCFID 與 CFIDS，描述器按 CFI 遞增排列。CNTLID=FFFFh 時清單含至少一台控制器回報的項目；每筆 ACNTL=1 才表示所有控制器都回報這項。
claims.en: The enhanced log has a 16-byte header with version, query attributes, CNTLID, SZE, NCFID and CFIDS. Descriptors are sorted by CFI. With CNTLID=FFFFh, entries are reported by at least one controller; ACNTL=1 means every controller reports that item.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 增強格式：分清至少一台與全部控制器
claims.heading_en: Enhanced format: distinguish some controllers from all
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.20, printed pages 282-283, PDF pages 308-309

claims.zh_tw: Lockdown 使用 CDW10 的 CSEL、OFI、IFC、PRHBT、SCP，以及 CDW14 的 CSS／UIDX。PRHBT=1 禁止、0 允許；其他欄位保留原本要作用的種類、介面與控制器集合。重複禁止已禁止項目或允許已允許項目，本身不是錯誤。
claims.en: Lockdown uses CSEL, OFI, IFC, PRHBT and SCP in CDW10, plus CSS/UIDX in CDW14. PRHBT=1 prohibits and zero allows; the other selectors define the operation, interface and controller set. Repeating an existing prohibition or allowance is not itself an error.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 完整編碼一次禁止與解除操作
claims.heading_en: Encode one prohibition and its removal
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.16, printed pages 405-407, PDF pages 431-433

claims.zh_tw: Lockdown 設定本身可因項目不可禁止、介面不支援或控制器選擇無效而失敗。28h 是 Prohibition of Command Execution Not Supported；1Fh 是 Invalid Controller Identifier。已受限制的 Admin 命令則回通用狀態 Command Prohibited by Command and Feature Lockdown。
claims.en: The Lockdown request can fail because the item is not prohibitable, an interface does not support it, or a controller selection is invalid. Command-specific 28h means Prohibition of Command Execution Not Supported and 1Fh means Invalid Controller Identifier. A subsequently prohibited Admin command instead returns the generic Command Prohibited by Command and Feature Lockdown status.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 把設定失敗與命令被禁止分開判斷
claims.heading_en: Separate a rejected configuration from a prohibited command
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.16, printed pages 407-408, PDF pages 433-434

claims.zh_tw: CSEL=0 的全體限制在 Lockdown Persistence 啟用時跨 power cycle 保留；停用時持續到 subsystem power cycle 或後續解除。CSEL=1、2 的限制持續到 power cycle 或後續解除，不因 LDPE=1 自動取得全體限制的跨斷電保留規則。
claims.en: A CSEL=0 prohibition persists across power cycles when Lockdown Persistence is enabled; otherwise it lasts until a subsystem power cycle or subsequent allowance. CSEL=1/2 prohibitions last until a power cycle or allowance and do not inherit subsystem-wide power-cycle persistence from LDPE=1.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 限制何時消失，要看 CSEL 與持續性設定
claims.heading_en: Follow restrictions across allowance and power cycles
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.5, printed pages 598-599, PDF pages 624-625

claims.zh_tw: 廠商定義 FID 的 Lockdown 在 SCP=2 且相關命令與項目支援 UUID 選擇時，使用 CDW14.UIDX 選 UUID List 項目。LID 14h 對 SCP=2 的廠商 FID 查詢也可使用 UIDX；SCP≠2 時忽略 UIDX。UIDX 是清單索引，不是 FID 或 byte offset。
claims.en: For a vendor-specific FID, Lockdown uses CDW14.UIDX when SCP=2 and UUID selection is supported for the commands and item involved. LID 14h can likewise use UIDX for vendor FIDs with SCP=2; other scopes ignore it. UIDX is a UUID List index, not a FID or byte offset.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 同一廠商 FID 有不同定義時，用 UUID 選版本
claims.heading_en: Select the intended vendor definition with a UUID
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.16, printed pages 406-407, PDF pages 432-433

claims.zh_tw: 持續性啟用時，未凍結或無認證解凍支援的 Lockdown Persistence Personality，不能透過 Lockdown 禁止 Set Features 或 FID 22h。若任一 personality 支援認證解凍，特定 CDP Authentication 的 Security Send／Receive 必須仍被允許。
claims.en: With persistence enabled, an unfrozen Lockdown Persistence Personality or one without authenticated unfreeze support prevents Lockdown from prohibiting Set Features or FID 22h. If any personality supports authenticated unfreeze, the specified CDP Authentication Security Send/Receive operations remain allowed.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 持續性啟用時，未凍結或無認證解凍支援的 Lockdown Persistence Personality，不能透過 Lockdown 禁止 Set Features 或 FID 22h。若任一 personality 支援認證解凍，特定 CDP Authentication 的 Security Send／Receive 必須仍被允許。
claims.heading_en: With persistence enabled, an unfrozen Lockdown Persistence Personality or one without authenticated unfreeze support prevents Lockdown from prohibiting Set Features or FID 22h. If any personality supports authenticated unfreeze, the specified CDP Authentication Security Send/Receive operations remain allowed.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.25.4.1, printed pages 494, PDF pages 520

claims.zh_tw: UIDX=0 不指定 UUID；非零索引需指向該資訊支援的有效 UUID。全 0、NVMe Invalid UUID 或不支援於該資訊的 UUID 會導向 Invalid Field in Command。
claims.en: UIDX=0 selects no UUID. A nonzero index must identify a valid UUID supported for the information; zero, NVMe Invalid UUID or an unsupported UUID produces Invalid Field in Command.
claims.heading_zh_tw: UIDX=0 不指定 UUID
claims.heading_en: UIDX=0 selects no UUID. A nonzero index must identify a valid UUID supported for the information
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.31.2, printed pages 737-738, PDF pages 763-764

claims.zh_tw: 受限制的操作從 Admin Queue 收到時，命令以 Command Prohibited by Command and Feature Lockdown 中止；從 Management Endpoint 收到時，回 Access Denied Error Response。
claims.en: A prohibited operation received on the Admin Queue is aborted with Command Prohibited by Command and Feature Lockdown; a Management Endpoint returns an Access Denied Error Response.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 受限制的操作從 Admin Queue 收到時，命令以 Command Prohibited by Command and Feature Lockdown 中止
claims.heading_en: A prohibited operation received on the Admin Queue is aborted with Command Prohibited by Command and Feature Lockdown
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.5, 文件頁 598, PDF 頁 624
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.5, printed pages 598, PDF pages 624

claims.zh_tw: LSP 同時選查詢種類與格式，不是只有一個「查 Lockdown」的開關。
claims.en: Figure 274, "Command and Feature Lockdown Log Specific Parameter Field": LSP selects both the list meaning and its format.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.20, Figure 274, 文件頁 280, PDF 頁 306
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.20, Figure 274, printed pages 280, PDF pages 306

claims.zh_tw: 只有 ELPF=1 時，LSI 才被本 Log 解讀為 CNTLID。
claims.en: Figure 275, "Controller Identifier - Log Specific Identifier": The log interprets LSI as CNTLID only in enhanced format.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.20, Figure 275, 文件頁 280, PDF 頁 306
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.20, Figure 275, printed pages 280, PDF pages 306

claims.zh_tw: 一般 Log 以 byte 長度限制代碼清單，不能掃到保留區。
claims.en: Figure 276, "Command and Feature Lockdown Log Page": The basic log uses a byte count to delimit its code list.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.20, Figure 276, 文件頁 281, PDF 頁 307
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.20, Figure 276, printed pages 281, PDF pages 307

claims.zh_tw: 增強 header 分開提供總長度、項目數與每筆步距。
claims.en: Figure 277, "Command and Feature Lockdown Log Page – Enhanced": The enhanced header separates total size, item count and descriptor stride.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.20, Figure 277, printed pages 282-283, PDF pages 308-309

claims.zh_tw: ACNTL=0 仍是一筆有控制器回報的項目，只是不是全部都有。
claims.en: Figure 278, "Command and Feature Identifier Descriptor": ACNTL=0 means at least one but not all controllers report the entry.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.20, Figure 278, 文件頁 283, PDF 頁 309
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.20, Figure 278, printed pages 283, PDF pages 309

claims.zh_tw: CDW10 的五個選擇共同決定限制，PRHBT 自己不能表達完整意圖。
claims.en: Figure 365, "Lockdown – Command Dword 10": Five CDW10 selectors jointly define the restriction; PRHBT alone is insufficient.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.16, Figure 365, 文件頁 405-406, PDF 頁 431-432
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.16, Figure 365, printed pages 405-406, PDF pages 431-432

claims.zh_tw: CSS 的意義由 CSEL 決定，UIDX 則是另一層廠商定義選擇。
claims.en: Figure 366, "Lockdown – Command Dword 14": CSEL determines the meaning of CSS; UIDX separately selects a vendor definition.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.16, Figure 366, 文件頁 407, PDF 頁 433
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.16, Figure 366, printed pages 407, PDF pages 433

claims.zh_tw: Lockdown 的 1Fh／28h 描述設定命令失敗，不是後續操作受限制的 23h。
claims.en: Figure 367, "Lockdown – Command Specific Status Values": Lockdown-specific 1Fh/28h describe failed configuration, not the later prohibited-command status.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.16, Figure 367, 文件頁 408, PDF 頁 434
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.16, Figure 367, printed pages 408, PDF pages 434

claims.zh_tw: Lockdown 是獨立的 Admin 命令，OFI 是它要管理的目標。
claims.en: Figure 28, "Admin Command Support Requirements": Lockdown has its own Admin opcode; OFI identifies its target.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.1.3, Figure 28, 文件頁 45-46, PDF 頁 71-72
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.1.3, Figure 28, printed pages 45-46, PDF pages 71-72

claims.zh_tw: 命令外框、目標操作與回傳 buffer 屬於不同層次。
claims.en: Figure 93, "Common Command Format": The command envelope, target operation and returned data buffer are separate layers.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.1.1, Figure 93, 文件頁 140-142, PDF 頁 166-168

claims.en: Figure 99, "Completion Queue Entry: DW 3": CQE DW3 separates command identity from status so completions can be matched correctly.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.2.1, Figure 99, 文件頁 145, PDF 頁 171
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.2.1, Figure 99, printed pages 145, PDF pages 171

claims.en: Figure 101, "Completion Queue Entry: Status Field": Interpret SC together with SCT; the phase tag is not part of the status code.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.2.3, Figure 101, 文件頁 145-146, PDF 頁 171-172
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.2.3, Figure 101, printed pages 145-146, PDF pages 171-172

claims.zh_tw: 通用 SC=23h 指出命令因現有 Lockdown 限制而中止。
claims.en: Figure 103, "Status Code – Generic Command Status Values": Generic SC=23h reports a command rejected by an existing Lockdown prohibition.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.2.3.1, Figure 103, printed pages 147,149, PDF pages 173,175

claims.zh_tw: Log 資料經 DPTR 回主機記憶體，CQE 回的是完成結果。
claims.en: Figure 203, "Get Log Page – Data Pointer": DPTR identifies the host buffer receiving the log; the CQE reports completion.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13, Figure 203, 文件頁 213, PDF 頁 239
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13, Figure 203, printed pages 213, PDF pages 239

claims.zh_tw: NUMDL 計 Dword 數減 1，LSP 另決定 Log 的問題。
claims.en: Figure 204, "Get Log Page – Command Dword 10": NUMDL encodes Dword count minus one while LSP selects the log query.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13, Figure 204, 文件頁 213, PDF 頁 239
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13, Figure 204, printed pages 213, PDF pages 239

claims.en: Figure 205, "Get Log Page – Command Dword 11": CDW11 combines a log-specific identifier with the high portion of the transfer count.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13, Figure 205, 文件頁 214, PDF 頁 240
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13, Figure 205, printed pages 214, PDF pages 240

claims.zh_tw: LPOL 選起讀位置，不能代替清單的項目數。
claims.en: Figure 206, "Get Log Page – Command Dword 12": LPOL specifies where reading starts, independently of item counts.

claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13, Figure 206, printed pages 214, PDF pages 240

claims.zh_tw: LPOU 是同一個 64-bit 起點的高位，不是第二段 buffer 的起點。
claims.en: Figure 207, "Get Log Page – Command Dword 13": LPOU extends the same 64-bit starting offset rather than selecting another buffer.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13, Figure 207, 文件頁 214, PDF 頁 240
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13, Figure 207, printed pages 214, PDF pages 240

claims.zh_tw: OT 選 offset 單位，UIDX 選廠商定義，兩者不能混用。
claims.en: Figure 208, "Get Log Page – Command Dword 14": OT chooses offset units; UIDX independently selects a vendor definition.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13, Figure 208, 文件頁 214-215, PDF 頁 240-241
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13, Figure 208, printed pages 214-215, PDF pages 240-241

claims.zh_tw: Personality Properties 的 AUS 說明能否認證解凍，MRSTT 說明設定所需的 reset 條件。
claims.en: Figure 292, "Personality Properties Data Structure": AUS describes authenticated unfreeze support and MRSTT describes the reset required for a change.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.28, Figure 292, printed pages 291-293, PDF pages 317-319

claims.zh_tw: OACS 的兩個能力位元分別保證基本範圍與控制器擴充範圍。
claims.en: Figure 338, "Identify – Identify Controller Data Structure, I/O Command Set Independent": OACS distinguishes basic Lockdown from controller-scoped support.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.1, Figure 338, 文件頁 352, PDF 頁 378
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.1, Figure 338, printed pages 352, PDF pages 378

claims.zh_tw: UUID List 從索引 1 開始，前 32bytes 保留，不能把 offset0 當第一項。
claims.en: Figure 347, "UUID List": The UUID List starts at index one after a reserved 32-byte region.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.14, Figure 347, 文件頁 396, PDF 頁 422
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.14, Figure 347, printed pages 396, PDF pages 422

claims.zh_tw: 一個 32-byte entry 裡，UUID 本體只占後 16bytes。
claims.en: Figure 348, "UUID List Entry": The UUID occupies the final sixteen bytes of each thirty-two-byte entry.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.14, Figure 348, 文件頁 396, PDF 頁 422
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.14, Figure 348, printed pages 396, PDF pages 422

claims.zh_tw: PERID02h 是 FID22h 裡的一種 personality，不是 FID02h。
claims.en: Figure 512, "Personality Identifier List": PERID02h selects a personality within FID22h, not Feature02h.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.25, Figure 512, 文件頁 485, PDF 頁 511
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.25, Figure 512, printed pages 485, PDF pages 511

claims.zh_tw: 改設定與凍結是獨立位元，PERID 選擇它們操作的對象。
claims.en: Figure 513, "Configurable Device Personality - Command Dword 13": CHPS changes settings, PERFS requests freezing and PERID chooses the personality.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.25, Figure 513, printed pages 485-486, PDF pages 511-512

claims.zh_tw: DW0 回待生效與凍結狀態，不能只讀 DW1 的 LDPS 就省略它。
claims.en: Figure 514, "Configurable Device Personality – Get Features Completion Queue Entry Dword 0": DW0 reports pending and freeze state separately from the persistence value in DW1.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.25, Figure 514, printed pages 486-487, PDF pages 512-513

claims.zh_tw: LDPE 是全體限制的跨 power-cycle 設定，不是立即禁止某個 OFI。
claims.en: Figure 518, "Lockdown Persistence Personality – Command Dword 11": LDPE enables persistence for all-controller prohibitions; it does not select an OFI.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.25.4, Figure 518, 文件頁 493, PDF 頁 519
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.25.4, Figure 518, printed pages 493, PDF pages 519

claims.en: Figure 519, "Lockdown Persistence Personality – Completion Queue Entry Dword 1": LDPS in CQE DW1 reports current persistence state, not a prohibited-item count.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.25.4, Figure 519, 文件頁 494, PDF 頁 520
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.25.4, Figure 519, printed pages 494, PDF pages 520

claims.zh_tw: UIDX 只指定 UUID 清單位置，0 代表不指定。
claims.en: Figure 782, "UUID Index Field": UIDX selects a UUID List position, with zero meaning no UUID selected.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.31.2, Figure 782, 文件頁 738, PDF 頁 764
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.31.2, Figure 782, printed pages 738, PDF pages 764

claims.zh_tw: FDP 讓主機依資料使用方式安排寫入，目標是減少媒體回收時搬移仍有效資料的成本。功能以 Endurance Group 為範圍；LBA 決定邏輯位置，Placement Identifier 則透過 namespace 的對照關係選擇目前接收資料的 Reclaim Unit。
claims.en: FDP lets the host organize writes around data usage to reduce valid-data movement during reclamation. It operates within an Endurance Group. LBA selects a logical address, while a Placement Identifier follows a namespace mapping to the Reclaim Unit currently receiving data.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 先看資料為何需要一起回收
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.12.1, printed pages 647-650, PDF pages 673-676

claims.zh_tw: 一個 RU 同時最多由一個 RUH 參照，因此不同 RUH 的新寫入起初分開。Initially Isolated 允許控制器搬移後在同一 Reclaim Group 合併同類型 RUH 的資料；Persistently Isolated 則要求搬移目的 RU 只包含同一 RUH 寫入的資料。
claims.en: An RU is referenced by at most one RUH, so new writes using different handles start separately. Initially Isolated handles allow relocated data from different handles of that type to be combined within the same Reclaim Group. Persistently Isolated handles require a destination RU containing only data written through the same handle.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 初次分開寫入，搬移後是否仍分開
claims.heading_en: Isolation before and after internal relocation
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.12.1, printed pages 649-650, PDF pages 675-676

claims.zh_tw: LID 20h 回傳 Endurance Group 的配置清單。先讀整份大小與每筆 DSZE，再檢查 FDPCV、NRG、NRUH、RUHT、RUNS 等內容。RGIF 決定 16-bit PID 高位有多少 bits 是 RGID，剩餘低位才是 PHNDL；配置索引不是 byte offset。
claims.en: LID 20h lists configurations for an Endurance Group. Use the log size and each DSZE, then inspect FDPCV, NRG, NRUH, RUHT, RUNS, and related fields. RGIF assigns the high bits of the 16-bit PID to RGID and the remaining low bits to PHNDL. A configuration index is not a byte offset.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 讀懂候選配置與 PID 的切割方式
claims.heading_en: Read configurations and the PID layout
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.29, printed pages 293-296, PDF pages 319-322

claims.zh_tw: 先查 FDPS 與有效配置，讓目標 Endurance Group 沒有 namespace，再以 FID 1Dh、SV=1 設定 FDPE 與 FDPCIDX。設定值改變後需重新取得資料格式資訊，再建立 namespace；FDP 設定成功改變也會清除該群組的 FDP 事件與統計。
claims.en: Check FDPS and valid configurations, ensure the target Endurance Group has no namespaces, then set FID 1Dh with SV=1, FDPE and FDPCIDX. After a value change, refresh data-format information before creating namespaces. A successful feature-value change also clears that group’s FDP events and statistics.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 啟用的是整個 Endurance Group
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.12.2, printed pages 651-652, PDF pages 677-678

claims.zh_tw: NPHNDLS 與 Placement Handle List 建立 namespace 私有的 PHNDL→RUHID 對照。主機可明確列出不同 RUH；NPHNDLS=0 則由控制器選一個 RUH 作為 PHNDL 0。共享 RUH 的 namespace 必須使用相同資料格式，且控制器選用與主機明確指定的 RUH 有分配限制。
claims.en: NPHNDLS and the Placement Handle List define a namespace-local PHNDL→RUHID mapping. A host may list distinct RUHs; NPHNDLS=0 asks the controller to choose one for PHNDL 0. Namespaces sharing an RUH must use the same data format, and controller-selected and explicitly selected handles have allocation restrictions.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 建立 namespace 的 Placement Handle 對照表
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §4.1.6.3, printed pages 110-113, PDF pages 110-113

claims.zh_tw: FDP 已啟用的群組內，namespace 還需要啟用 Data Placement Directive 才能明確指定 PID。Enable 使用外層 Identify DTYPE=00h，CDW12 目標 DTYPE=02h；Data Placement 本身沒有 Send／Receive 操作。沒有使用 Directive 的寫入則使用 PHNDL 0，讓控制器選 Reclaim Group。
claims.en: Within an FDP-enabled group, enable the namespace’s Data Placement Directive before explicitly specifying a PID. Enable uses outer Identify DTYPE=00h and target DTYPE=02h in CDW12. Data Placement has no Send/Receive operations of its own. Writes without a directive use PHNDL 0 and a controller-selected Reclaim Group.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 分清兩次啟用與三種 Write 情況
claims.heading_en: Two enablement steps and three Write cases
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.9.4, 文件頁 627, PDF 頁 653
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.9.4, printed pages 627, PDF pages 653

claims.zh_tw: 明確放置的 Write 用 DTYPE=02h、DSPEC=PID；LBA 與區塊數仍決定邏輯資料。PID 的 RGID 或 PHNDL 無效時，控制器另選該 namespace 可存取的 RG／RUH 來處理放置，並在所選 RUH 已啟用該事件時記錄 Invalid Placement Identifier；不能把這個規則套到 Update。
claims.en: An explicit-placement Write uses DTYPE=02h and DSPEC=PID while LBA and block count define the logical data. If RGID or PHNDL is invalid, the controller chooses an accessible RG/RUH and records Invalid Placement Identifier if enabled on the selected RUH. This Write rule does not apply to Update.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 把一筆 Write 走完，包含非法 PID
claims.heading_en: Follow one Write, including invalid PIDs
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.12.3, 文件頁 652, PDF 頁 678
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.12.3, printed pages 652, PDF pages 678

claims.zh_tw: I/O Management Receive 的 MO=01h 逐一回傳 namespace 每個 PHNDL、每個 RG 的狀態。NVM 描述器含 PID、RUHID、EARUTR 秒數與 RUAMW logical blocks；回覆是處理當下的狀態，未必反映其他未完成命令，且 RUNS 只是名目大小。
claims.en: I/O Management Receive MO=01h reports each namespace PHNDL for each RG. NVM descriptors contain PID, RUHID, EARUTR in seconds, and RUAMW in logical blocks. Each descriptor reflects processing-time state, may not reflect outstanding commands, and need not match nominal RUNS.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 查目前可寫容量，別把回覆當成永久保證
claims.heading_en: Inspect available writes and remaining time
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.2.1.1, 文件頁 26, PDF 頁 26
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.2.1.1, printed pages 26, PDF pages 26

claims.zh_tw: I/O Management Send MO=01h 接收 PID 清單，將已寫入的 RU 參照換到空 RU；若原本已空，可換也可不換。非法 PID 或超出限制會拒絕命令，但失敗前可能已有部分更新。與 Update 重疊處理的 Write 可能落在更新前或更新後的 RU。
claims.en: I/O Management Send MO=01h takes a PID list and moves a written RU reference to an empty RU; an already-empty RU may be retained or changed. Invalid PIDs or excess limits cause rejection, but partial updates may already have occurred. Writes processed concurrently may use the RU before or after the update.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 主機要求換一個空 RU，舊資料仍有自己的生命週期
claims.heading_en: Request a fresh RU without erasing old data
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §7.4.1.1, printed pages 570-571, PDF pages 596-597

claims.zh_tw: LID 21h 按 RUHID 回報 RUHA：0 未被 namespace 使用，1 由主機明確指定，2 由控制器選用。這份清單以 Endurance Group 為範圍，最多一個 RUH 的屬性為 2；它不列每個 RG 的剩餘可寫量，後者需要 I/O Management Receive。
claims.en: LID 21h reports RUHA by RUHID: zero unused by namespaces, one explicitly host-selected, and two controller-selected. The Endurance Group list has at most one type-2 entry. It does not report available writes per RG; use I/O Management Receive for that.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Usage 查誰配置了 RUH，不查剩多少容量
claims.heading_en: Usage reports allocation, not remaining capacity
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.30, printed pages 296-297, PDF pages 322-323

claims.zh_tw: LID 22h 的 HBMW 計主機寫入，MBMW 同時包含主機與控制器內部寫入，MBE 計媒體擦除量，皆為含對應 metadata 的相關 byte 計數。比較相同配置期間的增量，才可用 ΔMBMW/ΔHBMW 觀察寫入放大；不能把擦除量加到分子，或跨清零直接相減。
claims.en: LID 22h records host writes in HBMW, host plus internal controller writes in MBMW, and erased bytes in MBE, with the relevant data/metadata accounting. Compare deltas within the same configuration interval to observe write amplification as ΔMBMW/ΔHBMW. Do not add erased bytes to the numerator or subtract across a reset of the counters.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 用相同量測期間判斷寫入放大
claims.heading_en: Measure writes over the same interval
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.31, printed pages 297-298, PDF pages 323-324

claims.zh_tw: FID 1Eh 透過 NSID＋PHNDL 選 RUH，為列出的事件類型啟用或停用紀錄。Get 回支持的事件與目前啟用狀態，Set 送事件類型清單；共享 RUH 的 namespace 也共享該 RUH 的設定效果。LID 23h 才是已發生事件的紀錄。
claims.en: FID 1Eh selects an RUH through NSID plus PHNDL and enables or disables the listed event types. Get returns supported types and enablement; Set supplies a type list. Namespaces sharing the RUH share the effect of its settings. LID 23h contains events that actually occurred.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 先替 RUH 選事件，再讀已發生的紀錄
claims.heading_en: Enable events on handles before reading records
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.22, printed pages 481-483, PDF pages 507-509

claims.zh_tw: LID 23h 一次選 host 或 controller events，依發生先後回傳 64-byte 紀錄。先看 ETYP，再用 PIV／NSIDV／LV 判斷哪些識別欄位有效。Media Reallocated 的 NVM 擴充還要讀 LBAV、NLBAM 和一個示例 LBA；事件時間戳不保證數值遞增。
claims.en: LID 23h selects either host or controller events and returns 64-byte records in occurrence order. Read ETYP, then PIV/NSIDV/LV to determine which identifiers are valid. The NVM Media Reallocated extension adds LBAV, NLBAM and one example LBA. Timestamp values are not guaranteed to increase.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 把事件的原因、位置與資料量讀完整
claims.heading_en: Interpret event causes, locations and moved data
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.32, printed pages 298-301, PDF pages 324-327

claims.zh_tw: 降低回收成本，需要主機追蹤一整個 RU 內資料的使用週期；資料不再需要時，可用 Dataset Management AD=1 指出其 LBA 範圍。RUH Update 只改未來寫入的參照。Reset 後重新查配置、事件、namespace 的 PID 狀態與 cache，不要將保留啟用狀態誤認為所有 RU 狀態不變。
claims.en: Reducing reclamation cost requires tracking the useful lifetime of data written into an RU. When no longer needed, Dataset Management AD=1 can identify its LBA ranges. RUH Update changes the reference for future writes. After reset, refresh configuration, event settings, PID state and cache information; preserved enablement does not imply unchanged RU state.

claims.zh_tw: Directives 讓主機與控制器交換額外資訊。Streams 用主機指定的 Stream Identifier，指出哪些寫入資料屬於同一組；控制器可利用分組改善資料配置或效能，但這個編號不直接指定 NAND 的實體位置。
claims.en: Directives exchange additional information between the host and controller. Streams uses a host-selected Stream Identifier to associate writes with a group. The controller may use that grouping for placement or performance improvements; the identifier does not select a physical NAND address.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 先理解 Streams 要解決什麼問題
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.9, 8.1.9.1, 8.1.9.3, printed pages 616-623, PDF pages 642-649

claims.zh_tw: FID 81h 登記 Host Identifier，讓同一 NVM subsystem 內的控制器辨認共同主機。相同非零值可建立共同身分；0h 則表示不與其他控制器建立這種關聯。PCIe 的預設值為 0h，此 Feature 不可保存。
claims.en: FID 81h registers a Host Identifier so controllers in an NVM subsystem can recognize a common host. Equal nonzero values establish that identity; 0h does not associate a controller with other controllers. The PCIe default is 0h and this Feature is not saveable.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 先讓控制器知道哪些路徑屬於同一主機
claims.heading_en: Identify the host across controller paths
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.35, 5.2.30.1.35.1, printed pages 508-510, PDF pages 534-536

claims.zh_tw: 先由 OACS.DIRS 確認 Directives，再用 Identify Directive 查 Streams 是否支援與啟用。Enable Directive 的 CDW11 選 Identify 操作，CDW12 才選要啟用的 Streams；namespace 與 Host Identifier 一起決定共享的啟用狀態。
claims.en: First check OACS.DIRS, then query Streams support and enablement through the Identify Directive. For Enable Directive, CDW11 selects the Identify operation and CDW12 selects Streams as the target. Namespace and Host Identifier determine the shared enable state.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 查支援、登記身分，再啟用 Streams
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.9, 8.1.9.2, 8.1.9.3, printed pages 616-624, PDF pages 642-650

claims.zh_tw: Directive Receive 的資料由控制器送往主機，Directive Send 則相反；實際是否有資料傳輸取決於操作。CDW11 用 DTYPE／DOPER 選操作，DSPEC 的含義由類型決定；需要 buffer 時，NUMD 是 Dword 數量減 1。
claims.en: Directive Receive transfers data toward the host and Directive Send toward the controller, when the selected operation transfers data. CDW11 selects DTYPE/DOPER and type-specific DSPEC. For buffer transfers, NUMD encodes the Dword count minus one.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 讀懂 Directive 命令的欄位與資料方向
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.7, 5.2.8, printed pages 201-202, PDF pages 227-228

claims.zh_tw: Streams 可使用 namespace 的專用資源，或使用尚未專用配置的 subsystem 資源。Allocate Resources 要求的是可同時追蹤的數量，回覆 NSA 可以小於 NSR；真正開啟串流，是後續 Write 使用尚未開啟的編號時。
claims.en: Streams uses either namespace-exclusive resources or subsystem resources not exclusively allocated. Allocate Resources requests concurrent tracking capacity; returned NSA may be smaller than NSR. A stream is opened when a later Write uses an identifier that is not already open.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 配置多少資源，與開了幾條串流分開看
claims.heading_en: Separate allocated capacity from open streams

claims.zh_tw: Stream Identifier 的意義要連同 namespace、Host Identifier 與 NSSC.SSID 判斷。SSID=0 時，不同非零主機身分的同號串流彼此獨立；SSID=1 時，同一 namespace 的同號串流可由不同非零主機身分共享。
claims.en: Interpret a Stream Identifier together with namespace, Host Identifier, and NSSC.SSID. With SSID=0, equal identifiers belonging to different nonzero host identities are separate streams. With SSID=1, those hosts may share the same numbered stream in the same namespace.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 同一個 Stream Identifier，到底是不是同一條串流
claims.heading_en: When equal Stream Identifiers mean the same stream

claims.zh_tw: 使用 Streams 的 Write 指定 DTYPE=1、DSPEC=非零 Stream Identifier；首次使用尚未開啟的編號時，控制器開啟串流。DTYPE=0 或 Streams 的 DSPEC=0 不使用串流分組；未啟用類型的處理還要看是否已有任何 I/O Directive 啟用。
claims.en: A Streams Write uses DTYPE=1 and a nonzero Stream Identifier in DSPEC. First use of an unopened identifier opens a stream. DTYPE=0 or a zero Streams DSPEC omits stream grouping; handling an unenabled type also depends on whether any I/O Directive is enabled.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 把一筆 Write 接到串流
claims.heading_en: Attach a Write to a stream
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.9.1, 8.1.9.3, printed pages 617-623, PDF pages 643-649

claims.zh_tw: NVM Command Set 的 SWS 以 logical blocks 為單位；SGS 則以 SWS 為單位。先用 namespace 的 logical block 大小換成 bytes，才能比較寫入對齊、傳輸長度與整組資料的解除配置範圍。
claims.en: For the NVM Command Set, SWS is measured in logical blocks; SGS is measured in SWS units. Convert through the namespace logical block size before comparing write alignment, transfer length, and group-sized deallocation ranges.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 把 SWS／SGS 換成實際的資料量
claims.heading_en: Convert SWS and SGS into data sizes
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §5.13, 文件頁 175, PDF 頁 175
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §5.13, printed pages 175, PDF pages 175

claims.zh_tw: Get Status 回報目前開啟的編號。Release Identifier 結束一個編號的本次串流關聯，專用資源仍可保留；Release Resources 歸還 namespace 的專用配置。停用、Format、刪除、寫入保護與 reset 則各有不同的狀態影響。
claims.en: Get Status reports open identifiers. Release Identifier ends the current association of one identifier while exclusive capacity can remain allocated; Release Resources returns the namespace-exclusive allocation. Disablement, Format, deletion, write protection, and reset have distinct effects.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 觀察串流、結束使用與處理狀態變更
claims.heading_en: Observe streams and end their use

claims.en: Figure 714, "Allocate Resources – Command Dword 12": NSR is the direct requested allocation count, not a zero-based count.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.9.3.1.3, Figure 714, 文件頁 626, PDF 頁 652
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.9.3.1.3, Figure 714, printed pages 626, PDF pages 652

claims.zh_tw: Allocate 的 CQE DW0.NSA 回實際配置數量，不能只看成功狀態或原始 NSR。
claims.en: Figure 715, "Allocate Resources – Completion Queue Entry Dword 0": Allocation CQE DW0.NSA reports the actual grant rather than echoing NSR.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.9.3.1.3, Figure 715, 文件頁 626, PDF 頁 652
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.9.3.1.3, Figure 715, printed pages 626, PDF pages 652

claims.zh_tw: CAP.MPSMIN 定義 MDTS 所使用的最小記憶體頁大小單位。
claims.en: Figure 36, "Offset 0h: CAP – Controller Capabilities": CAP.MPSMIN supplies the minimum memory-page unit used by MDTS.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.1.4.1, Figure 36, 文件頁 55-58, PDF 頁 81-84
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.1.4.1, Figure 36, printed pages 55-58, PDF pages 81-84

claims.zh_tw: Write 的 SLBA 是資料寫入起點，不是串流編號。
claims.en: Figure 70, "Write – Command Dword 10 and Command Dword 11": Write SLBA specifies the destination start independently of the Stream Identifier.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.6, Figure 70, 文件頁 54, PDF 頁 54
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.6, Figure 70, printed pages 54, PDF pages 54

claims.zh_tw: Write CDW12 把 DTYPE、CETYPE 與 NLB 放在不同 bit 範圍。
claims.en: Figure 71, "Write – Command Dword 12": Write CDW12 separates directive type, command extension selection, and zero-based block count.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.6, Figure 71, 文件頁 54, PDF 頁 54
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.6, Figure 71, printed pages 54, PDF pages 54

claims.zh_tw: CETYPE=0 時，Write CDW13 的高 16 bits 是 DSPEC，低位的 DSM 屬性是另一組提示。
claims.en: Figure 72, "Write – Command Dword 13 if CETYPE is cleared to 0h": For CETYPE=0, Write CDW13 places DSPEC in the upper sixteen bits, independently of DSM attributes.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.6, Figure 72, 文件頁 54-55, PDF 頁 54-55
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.6, Figure 72, printed pages 54-55, PDF pages 54-55

claims.zh_tw: 共同格式把命令識別、namespace、資料地址與命令專屬控制欄位分開。
claims.en: Figure 93, "Common Command Format": The common command format separates command identity, namespace, data pointers, and command-specific controls.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.1.1, Figure 93, 文件頁 140-142, PDF 頁 166-168
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §4.1.1, Figure 93, printed pages 140-142, PDF pages 166-168

claims.zh_tw: Admin opcode 表用來辨認 Directive Send／Receive，不是用來選某個 Streams 操作。
claims.en: Figure 143, "Opcodes for Admin Commands": The Admin opcode table identifies Directive Send/Receive; DTYPE and DOPER still select the operation.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5, Figure 143, 文件頁 176-177, PDF 頁 202-203
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5, Figure 143, printed pages 176-177, PDF pages 202-203

claims.zh_tw: Get Features 的 DPTR 是接收 HOSTID 結構的位置。
claims.en: Figure 197, "Get Features – Data Pointer": Get Features DPTR identifies the buffer used to return HOSTID for value queries.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12, Figure 197, 文件頁 209, PDF 頁 235
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12, Figure 197, printed pages 209, PDF pages 235

claims.zh_tw: Get Features CDW10 用 FID 選功能、SEL 選查詢種類。
claims.en: Figure 198, "Get Features – Command Dword 10": Get Features CDW10 selects the Feature Identifier and the requested value/capability class.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12, Figure 198, 文件頁 209-210, PDF 頁 235-236
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12, Figure 198, printed pages 209-210, PDF pages 235-236

claims.zh_tw: UIDX 是選擇相關 UUID 的索引，不能拿來存 Host Identifier。
claims.en: Figure 199, "Get Features – Command Dword 14": Get Features UIDX selects an associated UUID when applicable; it is not the Host Identifier.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12, Figure 199, 文件頁 210, PDF 頁 236
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12, Figure 199, printed pages 210, PDF pages 236

claims.zh_tw: SEL=3 的 CQE DW0 回覆 Feature 能力位元，不回覆 HOSTID 的數值。
claims.en: Figure 201, "Completion Queue Entry Dword 0 when Select is set to 11b": With SEL=3, CQE DW0 reports Feature capabilities rather than the numeric HOSTID.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12.2, Figure 201, 文件頁 212, PDF 頁 238
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12.2, Figure 201, printed pages 212, PDF pages 238

claims.zh_tw: Parameter Error Location 指命令參數的 byte／bit 位置，不是資料 LBA。
claims.en: Figure 212, "Error Information Log Entry Data Structure": Parameter Error Location identifies a command-field byte/bit location, not a data LBA.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.2, Figure 212, printed pages 218-220, PDF pages 244-246

claims.zh_tw: DIRS、HIDS 與 MDTS 分別回答 Directives 支援、128-bit 身分支援、傳輸上限。
claims.en: Figure 338, "Identify – Identify Controller Data Structure, I/O Command Set Independent": DIRS, HIDS, and MDTS independently describe Directives support, 128-bit identity support, and maximum transfer size.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.1, Figure 338, printed pages 342, 345, 347, 353, PDF pages 368, 371, 373, 379

claims.zh_tw: Set Features 的 DPTR 指向主機提供的 HOSTID。
claims.en: Figure 463, "Set Features – Data Pointer": Set Features DPTR locates the host-supplied HOSTID data.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30, Figure 463, 文件頁 456, PDF 頁 482
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30, Figure 463, printed pages 456, PDF pages 482

claims.zh_tw: Set Features 的 SV 控制保存要求，但 FID 81h 本身不允許保存。
claims.en: Figure 464, "Set Features – Command Dword 10": Set Features SV requests saving, but Host Identifier is not a saveable Feature.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30, Figure 464, 文件頁 457, PDF 頁 483
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30, Figure 464, printed pages 457, PDF pages 483

claims.zh_tw: Set Features 的 UIDX 選 UUID 關聯，與 CDW11.EXHID 的長度選擇不同。
claims.en: Figure 465, "Set Features – Command Dword 14": Set Features UIDX selects UUID association separately from EXHID width selection.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30, Figure 465, 文件頁 457, PDF 頁 483
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30, Figure 465, printed pages 457, PDF pages 483

claims.zh_tw: Admin 命令建立及調整控制器的工作環境；I/O 命令處理 namespace 的資料。Opcode 要連同命令集解讀，命令支援與目前是否允許執行也要分開確認。
claims.en: Admin commands establish and configure the operating environment; I/O commands act on namespace data. Interpret an opcode within its command set, and distinguish support from permission to execute in the current state.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 先分清管理命令與資料命令
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5, 5.1.1, printed pages 176-178, PDF pages 202-204

claims.zh_tw: Abort 用 SQID 與 CID 指定原命令。Abort 的成功 CQE 不保證原命令已立即中止；IANP 和原命令的 CQE 必須分別判讀。
claims.en: Abort identifies the original command by SQID and CID. A successful Abort CQE does not guarantee immediate termination; interpret IANP and the original command’s CQE separately.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Abort：要求中止與確認中止是兩件事
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.1, printed pages 181-182, PDF pages 207-208

claims.zh_tw: 主機先提交 Asynchronous Event Request，控制器再以完成這筆命令的方式回報事件。事件類型、事件資訊、相關 LID 與 Event Specific Parameter 共同決定後續該讀什麼。
claims.en: The host first submits an Asynchronous Event Request; the controller later completes it to report an event. Event type, event information, associated LID, and Event Specific Parameter determine the next observation.
claims.heading_zh_tw: AER：讓事件找到接收它的主機
claims.heading_en: AER: delivering events to the host
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.2, printed pages 183-191, PDF pages 209-217

claims.zh_tw: Firmware Image Download 傳送映像片段；Firmware Commit 依 CA 與 FS 決定保存及啟用。實際執行是先 Download 再 Commit，Spec 的編排則先介紹 Commit。
claims.en: Firmware Image Download transfers image pieces; Firmware Commit uses CA and FS to select storage and activation. Execution normally downloads before committing, while the specification presents Commit first.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Firmware：先看啟用選擇，再看映像怎麼送入
claims.heading_en: Firmware: activation choices and image transfer
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.9, 5.2.10, printed pages 202-206, PDF pages 228-232

claims.zh_tw: Format NVM 可變更媒體格式，也可依 SES 要求 secure erase。SES 決定要用 FNS 還是 SENS 判讀範圍；NSID 與 FNVMBS 再決定指定 namespace 或 broadcast 的行為。
claims.en: Format NVM changes the media format and can request secure erase through SES. SES selects FNS or SENS for scope interpretation; NSID and FNVMBS determine namespace and broadcast behavior.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Format：先決定影響誰，再決定新格式
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.11, printed pages 206-209, PDF pages 232-235

claims.zh_tw: Get Features 的 SEL 選擇 current、default、saved 或 supported capabilities。SEL=011b 時，CQE DW0 的 CHANG、NSSPEC、SVBL 是能力回覆，不是該 Feature 的目前設定值。
claims.en: Get Features SEL selects current, default, saved, or supported capabilities. With SEL=011b, CHANG, NSSPEC, and SVBL in CQE DW0 describe capabilities, not the feature’s current value.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Get Features：查目前值、預設值或支援能力
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12, printed pages 209-212, PDF pages 235-238

claims.zh_tw: 本單元整理 LID 00h、01h、02h、03h、04h、05h、12h、24h；06h、07h、08h、15h、81h 配合相應作業另行教學。Get Log Page 的長度、位移與事件保留是共同機制；各 Log 的範圍、單位與有效條件由其資料結構決定。
claims.en: This unit groups LIDs 00h, 01h, 02h, 03h, 04h, 05h, 12h, and 24h; LIDs 06h, 07h, 08h, 15h, and 81h are explained with their corresponding operations. Transfer length, offset, and event retention are common mechanisms; each log defines its scope, units, and validity conditions.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Log：先定位紀錄，再解讀紀錄裡的證據
claims.heading_en: Logs: select a record, then interpret its evidence

claims.zh_tw: Identify 通常回傳 4096-byte 結構；CNS 選結構，CSI 選命令集，NSID、CNTID 或 CNS-specific identifier 決定查詢對象。這幾個選擇值不能互相代替。
claims.en: Identify returns a 4096-byte structure. CNS selects its kind, CSI the command set, and NSID, CNTID, or a CNS-specific identifier the target. These selectors are not interchangeable.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Identify：建立控制器、namespace 與能力的地圖
claims.heading_en: Identify: map controllers, namespaces, and capabilities
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.1, 5.2.14.2, 5.2.14.5, printed pages 336-405, PDF pages 362-431

claims.zh_tw: Security Send 把安全協定資料送入控制器；Security Receive 取得相應結果。SECP 選協定，SPSP 與 NSSF 的意義由該協定決定，NVMe 命令成功不等於協定內每一步都已成功。
claims.en: Security Send supplies protocol data and Security Receive retrieves results. SECP selects the protocol; SPSP and NSSF are protocol-dependent. NVMe command success does not by itself prove success of every protocol operation.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Security Send／Receive：協定資料的傳遞介面
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.28, 5.2.29, printed pages 454-456, PDF pages 480-482

claims.zh_tw: Set Features 的 FID 選功能，SV 要求保存，命令專屬欄位或 buffer 承載設定。每個功能有各自的作用範圍、可變更條件與重設行為，不能只照同一種設定值模型解讀。
claims.en: Set Features uses FID to select a feature, SV to request saving, and feature-specific fields or buffers for values. Scope, changeability, and reset behavior are defined separately for each feature.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Set Features：把設定連到佇列、事件與電源行為
claims.heading_en: Set Features: connect settings to operating behavior
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1, 5.2.30.4, printed pages 456-514,519, PDF pages 482-540,545

claims.zh_tw: Interrupt Coalescing 與 Interrupt Vector Configuration 調整完成通知；HMB 讓控制器使用主機提供的記憶體。中斷設定不改寫 CQE 的完成語意，HMB 也不等於主機把記憶體所有權永久交出去。
claims.en: Interrupt Coalescing and Interrupt Vector Configuration control completion notification; HMB lends host memory to the controller. Interrupt settings do not redefine CQE completion, and HMB does not permanently transfer memory ownership.
claims.heading_zh_tw: PCIe 功能：中斷通知與借出的主機記憶體
claims.heading_en: PCIe features: interrupt delivery and borrowed memory
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.2, printed pages 514-519, PDF pages 540-545

claims.zh_tw: Create I/O SQ 以 CQID 指向已存在的 I/O CQ，因此通常先建立 CQ 再建立 SQ。刪除時先移除引用該 CQ 的 SQ；數量配置、佇列建立與正常送命令是不同步驟。
claims.en: Create I/O SQ uses CQID to reference an existing I/O CQ, so create the CQ first. Delete referencing SQs before deleting their CQ. Queue allocation, creation, and command submission are distinct steps.
claims.heading_zh_tw: I/O 佇列：先建立完成端，再接上提交端
claims.heading_en: I/O queues: create the completion side first
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.3.1–5.3.4, printed pages 527-532, PDF pages 553-558

claims.zh_tw: Flush 要求指定 namespace 的資料及 metadata 提交至 non-volatile media。它至少涵蓋在 Flush 提交前已完成的命令；同時仍在執行的 Write 不可自動視為被納入。
claims.en: Flush commits data and metadata for the specified namespace to non-volatile media. It covers at least commands completed before Flush submission; concurrently outstanding Writes are not automatically covered.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Flush：用完成界線說明持久保存
claims.heading_en: Flush: a completion boundary for persistence
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §7, 7.2, printed pages 564,567, PDF pages 590,593

claims.zh_tw: Compare 將指定 LBA 範圍的資料與主機提供的內容比對，並依設定處理 metadata／PI。成功表示符合比較條件；Compare Failure 是內容不相符，與無法讀取媒體不同。
claims.en: Compare checks a specified LBA range against host-provided content and handles metadata/PI according to its settings. Compare Failure denotes a mismatch, distinct from an unreadable medium.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Compare：把主機提供的內容拿來比對
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.1, 文件頁 27-29, PDF 頁 27-29
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.1, printed pages 27-29, PDF pages 27-29

claims.zh_tw: Copy 的 DPTR 指向來源範圍描述子，目的位置由命令指定。描述子格式、來源與目的格式的對應、MSRC／MSSRL／MCL 及完成回覆共同限制一次操作。
claims.en: Copy DPTR points to source-range descriptors, while the command identifies the destination. Descriptor format, source/destination format compatibility, MSRC/MSSRL/MCL, and completion reporting constrain the operation.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Copy：主機傳描述子，控制器搬資料
claims.heading_en: Copy: descriptors cross the host interface
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, 文件頁 30-43, PDF 頁 30-43
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, printed pages 30-43, PDF pages 30-43

claims.zh_tw: Dataset Management 以範圍清單提供存取屬性與 deallocate 要求。解除配置不保證媒體立即抹除，也不保證之後一定讀到零；範圍描述子的 LLB 是直接的 block count，不沿用 Read NLB 的加 1 編碼。
claims.en: Dataset Management supplies range attributes and deallocation requests. Deallocation guarantees neither immediate media erasure nor universally zero-filled reads, and its range-descriptor LLB is a direct block count, unlike Read’s NLB encoding.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Dataset Management：描述資料用途與解除配置
claims.heading_en: Dataset Management: usage hints and deallocation
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.3, 文件頁 44-48, PDF 頁 44-48
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.3, printed pages 44-48, PDF pages 44-48

claims.zh_tw: Read 用 SLBA 和 NLB 選 namespace 內的範圍，再依資料格式、metadata 配置及檢查設定把內容送入主機 buffer。命令欄位中的 block 數與 byte 數需要透過目前格式換算。
claims.en: Read selects a namespace range using SLBA and NLB, then transfers it to host buffers according to data format, metadata layout, and checking settings. Converting blocks to bytes requires the current format.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Read：把範圍、格式與主機 buffer 接起來
claims.heading_en: Read: connect ranges, formats, and host buffers
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.4, 文件頁 48-51, PDF 頁 48-51
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.4, printed pages 48-51, PDF pages 48-51

claims.zh_tw: Verify 對指定 LBA 範圍執行規格定義的驗證，不把正常 Read 的資料傳回主機，也不需要 Compare 的預期資料 buffer。它不能證明內容符合應用程式想要的值。
claims.en: Verify checks a specified LBA range without returning the normal Read payload or requiring Compare’s expected-data buffer. It does not prove that content matches an application’s intended value.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Verify：檢查可讀性，沒有主機比對資料
claims.heading_en: Verify: validate without a host comparison buffer
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.5, 文件頁 51-53, PDF 頁 51-53
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.5, printed pages 51-53, PDF pages 51-53

claims.zh_tw: Write 把主機提供的資料寫入指定 LBA 範圍。FUA、volatile write cache、原子寫入限制及 PI 檢查回答不同問題；單筆命令成功不能自動推論所有可能的持久性與原子性保證。
claims.en: Write stores host-provided data in a specified LBA range. FUA, volatile write cache, atomic-write limits, and PI checks address distinct questions; successful completion does not imply every persistence or atomicity guarantee.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Write：寫入內容、持久性與原子性分開看
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.6, 文件頁 53-56, PDF 頁 53-56
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.6, printed pages 53-56, PDF pages 53-56

claims.zh_tw: Write Uncorrectable 使指定範圍之後的存取呈現不可更正錯誤條件；Write Zeroes 要求規格定義的零值寫入結果。兩者都不需要主機傳送整批一般 user data，但效果完全不同。
claims.en: Write Uncorrectable establishes an uncorrectable-error condition for the specified range; Write Zeroes requests the defined zeroing result. Neither requires a normal full host data payload, but their effects differ fundamentally.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Write Uncorrectable 與 Write Zeroes：兩種不同結果
claims.heading_en: Write Uncorrectable and Write Zeroes: different outcomes
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.7, 3.3.8, printed pages 56-61, PDF pages 56-61

claims.zh_tw: Base 定義 AER 與 Format 的共同介面；NVM §4.1.1 補充事件資訊，§4.1.2 定義 Format 的 PIL、PI 與 MSET。此處在同一份 NVM PDF 連續補完，無須再回 Base。
claims.en: Base defines common AER and Format interfaces. NVM §4.1.1 adds event information and §4.1.2 defines Format PIL, PI, and MSET. Complete these additions in the NVM PDF without returning to Base.
claims.heading_zh_tw: NVM 補充：同一個 Admin 命令的資料語意
claims.heading_en: NVM additions to common Admin commands
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §4.1.1, 4.1.2, printed pages 62-63, PDF pages 62-63

claims.zh_tw: 本篇只補充 FID 02h、03h、0Ah：Power Management 的 NVM 行為、LBA Range Type 及 Write Atomicity Normal。LBA 用途描述不會自行建立分割區，DN 不會放大掉電原子性保證。
claims.en: This report adds only FIDs 02h, 03h, and 0Ah: NVM Power Management behavior, LBA Range Type, and Write Atomicity Normal. LBA usage descriptions do not create partitions, and DN does not enlarge power-failure atomicity guarantees.
claims.heading_zh_tw: NVM 功能補充：閒置退出延遲、LBA 用途與原子性
claims.heading_en: NVM features: idle exit latency, LBA usage, and atomicity
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §4.1.3.1, 4.1.3.2, 4.1.3.4, printed pages 64-67, PDF pages 64-67

claims.zh_tw: NVM §4.1.4.1 補充 Error Information 的 User Data，§4.1.4.2 補充 SMART／Health 的 NVM 計數語意。這些是既有 LID 01h、02h 的補充，不是兩個新的 Log。
claims.en: NVM §4.1.4.1 adds Error Information User Data and §4.1.4.2 adds NVM SMART/Health counter semantics. These extend LIDs 01h and 02h rather than defining new logs.
claims.heading_zh_tw: NVM Log 補充：把數值換回資料範圍與計數
claims.heading_en: NVM log additions: interpret ranges and counters
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §4.1.4.1, 4.1.4.2, printed pages 76, PDF pages 76

claims.zh_tw: NVM Identify 補上 namespace 容量、LBA 格式、metadata／PI、原子性和命令限制。CNS、CSI、NSID 與 Format Index 的組合決定查目前 namespace，或查某個支援格式。
claims.en: NVM Identify adds capacity, LBA formats, metadata/PI, atomicity, and command limits. CNS, CSI, NSID, and Format Index determine whether a query describes a current namespace or a supported format.
claims.heading_zh_tw: NVM Identify：用格式與上限驗算一筆 I/O
claims.heading_en: NVM Identify: validate an I/O against formats and limits
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §4.1.5, printed pages 83-110, PDF pages 83-110

claims.zh_tw: LBA Format List 分成共用能力的格式與具有不同能力的格式。NLBAF、NULBAF 決定數量，CNS 決定能查到哪一群；Format Index 則選定這次要解讀的格式。
claims.en: The LBA Format List separates formats with common capabilities from formats with distinct capabilities. NLBAF and NULBAF determine counts, CNS determines which groups are accessible, and Format Index selects the format to interpret.
claims.heading_zh_tw: LBA Format List：選定同一筆格式才能配對能力
claims.heading_en: LBA Format List: match capabilities to one format
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §5.6, printed pages 160-162, PDF pages 160-162

claims.zh_tw: Device Self-test 的命令完成表示已處理啟動或中止要求；背景作業進度與結果要從 LID 06h 分別讀取。STC 選動作，NSID 選測試對象，結果欄位的有效旗標決定哪些資訊可用。
claims.en: Device Self-test command completion acknowledges the start or abort request. LID 06h separately reports background progress and results. STC selects the action, NSID the target, and validity flags qualify result fields.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Device Self-test：從啟動要求到檢查結果
claims.heading_en: Device Self-test: from request to result

claims.zh_tw: Namespace Management 建立或刪除 namespace；Namespace Attachment 改變 controller 與 namespace 的連接關係。Create 成功回傳 NSID，不代表已附加；Detach 移除存取關係，不等於刪除資料對象。
claims.en: Namespace Management creates or deletes namespaces; Namespace Attachment changes controller associations. Create returns an NSID without automatically attaching it. Detach removes access rather than deleting the namespace object.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Namespace：建立儲存空間，再建立存取關係
claims.heading_en: Namespaces: create storage, then attach access
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.24, 5.2.25, printed pages 445-448, PDF pages 471-474

claims.zh_tw: Boot Partition 與一般 namespace 是不同對象。LID 15h 讀取所選 partition 的資訊與內容；Firmware Commit CA=6 寫入映像、CA=7 選啟動來源；FID 85h 管理寫入保護。
claims.en: Boot partitions are distinct from ordinary namespaces. LID 15h reads a selected partition, Firmware Commit CA=6 writes its image and CA=7 selects the boot source, and FID 85h controls write protection.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Boot Partition：讀映像、寫映像與切換啟動來源
claims.heading_en: Boot partitions: read, update, and select an image

claims.zh_tw: LID 07h 由主機要求建立 Telemetry，LID 08h 回報控制器建立的資料。讀取時要同時處理 512-byte block 邊界、累積 Data Area 範圍與 generation，避免拼接不同次擷取。
claims.en: LID 07h supports host-initiated telemetry; LID 08h reports controller-initiated data. Retrieval combines 512-byte block boundaries, cumulative data areas, and generation checks to avoid mixing captures.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Telemetry：完整取得同一次診斷資料
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.8, 5.2.13.1.9, printed pages 232-237, PDF pages 258-263

claims.zh_tw: Sanitize 依支援能力選 Block Erase、Overwrite 或 Crypto Erase；命令成功不表示背景清除已完成。LID 81h 回報狀態、進度與估計時間；FID 17h 的設定會影響要求不解除配置時的處理方式。
claims.en: Sanitize selects supported Block Erase, Overwrite, or Crypto Erase actions. Command success is not completion of background sanitization. LID 81h supplies state, progress, and estimates; FID 17h affects handling of no-deallocation requests.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Sanitize：清除要求、背景進度與最終狀態
claims.heading_en: Sanitize: request, background progress, and final state
