claims.zh_tw: NVM Command Set 補充 Base 的 logical-block 語意；logical block data size 不含 metadata，logical block size 則包含。NVM 的 CSI 是 00h，命令、Feature、log 與 Identify 的相同數字分屬不同識別空間。
claims.en: The NVM Command Set supplements Base with logical-block semantics. Logical block data size excludes metadata, whereas logical block size includes it. NVM uses CSI 00h; equal numeric values in commands, Features, logs, and Identify belong to different identifier spaces.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 閱讀地圖與單位

claims.zh_tw: NSZE ≥ NCAP ≥ NUSE；NSZE 定義可定址範圍，NCAP 限制同時配置的 blocks，NUSE 計算目前已配置 blocks。THINP=0 時 NCAP=NSZE；NVMCAP 以 bytes 計，不能直接當成 NSZE 乘資料大小。
claims.en: NSZE ≥ NCAP ≥ NUSE: NSZE defines the addressable range, NCAP limits simultaneously allocated blocks, and NUSE counts current allocation. THINP=0 requires NCAP=NSZE. NVMCAP is measured in bytes and is not necessarily NSZE multiplied by data size.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Namespace 容量與配置狀態
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.1; 4.1.5.1, printed pages 13-14,85-93, PDF pages 13-14,85-93

claims.zh_tw: 一般命令不因同在一個 SQ 就取得 LBA 相依順序；host 必須建立必要順序。Fused Compare-and-Write 先比對，成功才寫入；Compare 失敗則 Write 以 Failed Fused Command 類別中止。
claims.en: Ordinary commands do not gain LBA dependency ordering merely by sharing an SQ; the host enforces required order. Fused Compare-and-Write compares first and writes only on success; a failed Compare aborts Write with the failed-fused-command status.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 命令順序與 Compare-and-Write
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.2-2.1.3, printed pages 14-15, PDF pages 14-15

claims.zh_tw: AWUN／NAWUN 與 AWUPF／NAWUPF 分別描述正常及失敗條件原子性。Single Atomicity Mode 跨 boundary 不保證整筆原子；Multiple Atomicity Mode 在每個 boundary 切成各自原子的 subranges，並不承諾整筆一起成功。
claims.en: AWUN/NAWUN and AWUPF/NAWUPF describe normal and failure-condition atomicity. Single Atomicity Mode provides no whole-command guarantee across a boundary; Multiple Atomicity Mode divides the range at boundaries into separately atomic subranges, without promising one combined outcome.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 正常、斷電與多段原子性

claims.zh_tw: NVM I/O controller 必須支援 Read 與 Write；其他列出的 NVM 命令依各能力條件判斷。Opcode 低兩 bits 表示資料傳輸方向，狀態值必須連同 SCT 解讀，不能只用 SC 數值查錯誤。
claims.en: An NVM I/O controller must support Read and Write; other listed NVM commands depend on their capability conditions. The low two opcode bits identify transfer direction. Interpret status values with SCT rather than looking up SC alone.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 能力探索、Opcode 與狀態
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.2; 3.1; 3.3, printed pages 22-27, PDF pages 22-27

claims.zh_tw: Read／Write 以 SLBA 與 0-based NLB 指定連續範圍。Read 的 DPTR 是目的 buffer，Write 的 DPTR 是來源 buffer；FUA=1 要求使用 nonvolatile media，並沒有隱含其他命令的順序。
claims.en: Read/Write specify a contiguous range with SLBA and zero-based NLB. DPTR is a destination buffer for Read and a source buffer for Write. FUA=1 requires nonvolatile-media handling without implying ordering of other commands.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Read／Write 的資料與完成條件
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.4; 3.3.6, printed pages 48-51,53-56, PDF pages 48-51,53-56

claims.zh_tw: Compare 比較媒體資料與 host 提供的 buffer；Verify 檢查已儲存資料完整性而不把資料或 metadata 回傳 host。兩者要求 PRACT=0；Verify 與 Read 偵測到的失敗不必使用相同錯誤碼。
claims.en: Compare compares media data with a host-supplied buffer. Verify checks stored-data integrity without returning data or metadata to the host. Both require PRACT=0; Verify and Read need not report an identical error code for a detected failure.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Compare 與 Verify 解決不同問題
claims.heading_en: Compare and Verify answer different questions
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.1; 3.3.5, printed pages 27-30,51-53, PDF pages 27-30,51-53

claims.zh_tw: Copy 把一個或多個 source ranges 依 descriptor 順序接成單一連續目的範圍。Format 0h/1h 來源與目的在同一 namespace；2h/3h 帶 SNSID，需 controller 支援與 host 啟用。失敗 CQE DW0 是最低未成功 source index，後面的 ranges 仍可能已複製。
claims.en: Copy concatenates one or more source ranges in descriptor order into one contiguous destination range. Formats 0h/1h use one namespace; 2h/3h carry SNSID and require controller support and host enablement. Failure CQE DW0 is the lowest unsuccessful source index; later ranges may already have been copied.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Copy：描述來源、連續目的與部分失敗
claims.heading_en: Copy: source descriptors, contiguous destination, partial failure
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, 文件頁 30-44, PDF 頁 30-44
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, printed pages 30-44, PDF pages 30-44

claims.zh_tw: Copy 的 matching formats 要比對資料大小、metadata 大小、DPS、PIFA、有效 LBSTM、PIF／QPIF 與 STS。Corresponding PI formats 只容許有 PI 的一方 metadata 全為 PI，另一方完全沒有 metadata；不能拿 Copy 任意轉換資料格式。
claims.en: Matching Copy formats compare data size, metadata size, DPS, PIFA, significant LBSTM bits, PIF/QPIF, and STS. Corresponding PI formats require PI-only metadata on one side and no metadata on the other; Copy is not a general format converter.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Copy 的 PI 格式相容與轉換

claims.zh_tw: Dataset Management 是 advisory：處理 attributes 不等於一定執行 deallocate。NR 是 0-based，16-byte descriptor 的 LLB 是 1-based；DMRL、DMRSL、DMSL 分別約束 range 數、單一 range 長度與總長度。
claims.en: Dataset Management is advisory: processing attributes does not guarantee deallocation. NR is zero-based; LLB in each 16-byte descriptor is one-based. DMRL, DMRSL, and DMSL constrain range count, individual range length, and total length.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Dataset Management 與三種 processing limits
claims.heading_en: Dataset Management and three processing limits
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.3, 文件頁 44-48, PDF 頁 44-48
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.3, printed pages 44-48, PDF pages 44-48

claims.zh_tw: 支援且啟用 DULBE 時，Copy、Read、Verify、Compare 存取 deallocated／unwritten blocks 會失敗。未啟用時，DRB=001b 回零、010b 回 FFh、000b 可選其一；同 block 在下一次寫入前的回值須保持 deterministic。
claims.en: When supported and enabled, DULBE makes Copy, Read, Verify, and Compare fail on deallocated/unwritten blocks. Otherwise DRB=001b returns zeros, 010b returns FFh, and 000b allows either; a block must return a deterministic value until its next write.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Deallocated／unwritten 讀取規則
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.3.2.1; 4.1.3.3, printed pages 47-48,66, PDF pages 47-48,66

claims.zh_tw: Write Uncorrectable 將範圍標為無法修復的讀取錯誤；Write Zeroes 使成功的後續讀取資料及非 PI metadata 回零。NSZ=1 的整個 namespace 清零需 NSZS、DEAC=1 與零值 deallocation read behavior，且 host 應檢查 CQE.LBACZ。
claims.en: Write Uncorrectable marks a range for unrecovered-read errors. Write Zeroes makes subsequent successful reads return zero data and non-PI metadata. Whole-namespace zeroing with NSZ=1 requires NSZS, DEAC=1, and zero-valued deallocation reads; the host should check CQE.LBACZ.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Write Uncorrectable、Write Zeroes 與整體清零
claims.heading_en: Write Uncorrectable, Write Zeroes, and whole-namespace zeroing
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.7-3.3.8, printed pages 56-61, PDF pages 56-61

claims.zh_tw: Format NVM 選取已支援的 Format Index、PI type 與 metadata 傳輸方式。延伸 PI 及超過 legacy 16 個 entries 的 LBA formats 需檢查 controller ELBAS 與 host LBAFEE；沒有 host 啟用不可直接使用。
claims.en: Format NVM selects a supported Format Index, PI type, and metadata transfer method. Extended PI and formats beyond the legacy 16 entries require controller ELBAS and host LBAFEE checks; they cannot simply be used without host enablement.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Format、Host Behavior 與延伸 LBA
claims.heading_en: Format, Host Behavior, and extended LBAs
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §4.1.2; 4.1.3.7, printed pages 62-63,68-69, PDF pages 62-63,68-69

claims.zh_tw: FID 03h 描述 namespace LBA ranges，05h 控制 namespace error recovery，0Ah 控制 controller normal atomicity。Power Management 的 NVM 補充以 NPWG 大小的 Read 作為 Idle I/O Exit Latency Limit 的參考命令。
claims.en: FID 03h describes namespace LBA ranges, 05h controls namespace error recovery, and 0Ah controls controller normal atomicity. The NVM Power Management extension uses an NPWG-sized Read as the reference for Idle I/O Exit Latency Limit.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 基本 Features 的作用域與例外
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §4.1.3.1-4.1.3.4, printed pages 64-67, PDF pages 64-67

claims.zh_tw: NVM CSI=00h。完整 namespace 資訊需結合 CNS 08h 的 command-set-independent 結構、CNS 00h 的 NVM 結構與 CNS 05h／CSI 00h 的 NVM 延伸結構；CNS 01h 與 06h 則提供 controller 資訊。
claims.en: NVM uses CSI=00h. Complete namespace information combines the command-set-independent CNS 08h structure, the NVM CNS 00h structure, and NVM-specific CNS 05h/CSI 00h. CNS 01h and 06h supply controller information.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Identify：同一 namespace 的多份資料結構
claims.heading_en: Identify: multiple structures for one namespace
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §4.1.5, printed pages 83-110, PDF pages 83-110

claims.zh_tw: LBAF 與 ELBAF 以同一 Format Index 配對；總 format 數為 raw NLBAF+1+NULBAF。NLBAF 是 0-based、NULBAF 是實際數量。有效 index 還要檢查 LBADS：值 0 表示該支援格式目前不可用。
claims.en: LBAF and ELBAF pair at the same Format Index. Total format count is raw NLBAF+1+NULBAF: NLBAF is zero-based and NULBAF is an actual count. A valid index still requires checking LBADS; zero means that supported format is currently unavailable.
claims.heading_zh_tw: LBAF、ELBAF 與唯一屬性格式

claims.zh_tw: Namespace create 的 NVM payload 指定 NSZE、NCAP、FLBAS、DPS、LBSTM 與 placement handles。Namespace Size／Capacity Granularity 以 bytes 回報且是 hints；不符合 granularity 但其他條件合法時，不得僅因此拒絕 create。
claims.en: The NVM create payload specifies NSZE, NCAP, FLBAS, DPS, LBSTM, and placement handles. Namespace Size/Capacity Granularity are byte-valued hints; a create valid in other respects must not be rejected merely for failing these granularities.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 建立 namespace：格式、mask 與 granularity

claims.zh_tw: FDP namespace 的 placement handles 對應 Reclaim Unit Handles。共享 RUH 的 namespaces 必須使用相同 Format Index；host 指定的 handle list 不得重複 RUHID。RUH Status descriptors 先依 Placement Handle、再依 Reclaim Group Identifier 排序。
claims.en: FDP namespace placement handles map to Reclaim Unit Handles. Namespaces sharing a RUH must use the same Format Index, and host-specified handle lists cannot repeat RUHIDs. RUH Status descriptors sort first by Placement Handle, then by Reclaim Group Identifier.
claims.heading_zh_tw: FDP：placement、RUH 與可觀測數據
claims.heading_en: FDP: placement, RUHs, and observable data

claims.zh_tw: NUSE 的頻繁改變及 ANA 造成的 capacity 回報變動不產生 Namespace Attribute Changed 事件。Error Information 的 LBA 指最低發生錯誤的 LBA；Self-test FLBA 只在 valid bit 設定時有效，且可只代表多個失敗 blocks 中的一個。
claims.en: Frequent NUSE changes and ANA-induced capacity-report changes do not generate Namespace Attribute Changed events. Error Information reports the lowest erroneous LBA. Self-test FLBA is meaningful only with its valid bit and may identify only one of several failing blocks.
claims.heading_zh_tw: AER、SMART 與錯誤記錄的 NVM 補充
claims.heading_en: NVM extensions to AER, SMART, and error records

claims.zh_tw: LID 0Eh 先指出值得調查的 namespace ranges；Get LBA Status 再回詳細 descriptors。ATYPE=02h 回 tracked allocated LBAs，10h 掃描並回 tracked／untracked 候選，11h 只回 tracked 候選且不做 foreground scan。
claims.en: LID 0Eh first identifies namespace ranges worth investigating; Get LBA Status returns detailed descriptors. ATYPE=02h reports tracked allocated LBAs, 10h scans and returns tracked/untracked candidates, and 11h returns tracked candidates without a foreground scan.
claims.heading_zh_tw: LBA Status：通知、掃描與修復流程
claims.heading_en: LBA Status: notices, scans, and recovery

claims.zh_tw: FID 1Ch 用 ATTRI 選屬性：00h 為只讀標準效能，C0h 為只讀 identifier list，C1h..FFh 為 vendor attributes。Current、Default、Saved 是不同視圖，RVSPA 用來移除指定 vendor attribute 的 保存值。
claims.en: FID 1Ch selects attributes through ATTRI: 00h is read-only standard performance, C0h a read-only identifier list, and C1h..FFh vendor attributes. Current, Default, and Saved are distinct views; RVSPA removes a selected vendor attribute’s saved value.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Performance Characteristics 的屬性模型
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §4.1.3.8, printed pages 69-73, PDF pages 69-73

claims.zh_tw: FID 28h 以 TGT／TID 選 target，1024-byte buffer 指定 enable、mode、bandwidth、IOPS 與 write/read ratios。TGT=0 指 controller，不能指定 Admin controller 或保留 ID。此 Feature 必須可 save。
claims.en: FID 28h selects a target with TGT/TID and uses a 1024-byte buffer for enablement, mode, bandwidth, IOPS, and write/read ratios. TGT=0 selects a controller; an Admin controller or reserved ID is invalid. This Feature must be saveable.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Rate Limiting 的設定欄位

claims.zh_tw: LID 28h 以 log 起點為基準的 dword offsets 連接 port、controller 與 storage-medium access descriptors；descriptor 可共享，不能假設為固定順序陣列。分段讀取後應重讀 GC，改變時重收整份資料。
claims.en: LID 28h links ports, controllers, and storage-medium access descriptors using dword offsets from the log start. Descriptors may be shared rather than forming one fixed-order array. After chunked reads, reread GC and recollect if it changed.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Rate Limiting log 是能力圖
claims.heading_en: The Rate Limiting log is a capability graph
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §4.1.4.8; 5.10.3, printed pages 79-83,168-172, PDF pages 79-83,168-172

claims.zh_tw: Hard Limit 設 ceiling，Soft Limit 可利用未用 bandwidth／IOPS；資源不足時依設定比例分配。Appendix A 是多個 token buckets 的實作範例，不要求所有 controllers 採用相同內部實作。
claims.en: Hard Limit sets a ceiling; Soft Limit can use unused bandwidth/IOPS. Resource shortfalls are shared proportionally to configured limits. Appendix A illustrates multiple token buckets without requiring one identical controller implementation.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Hard／Soft 與 token-bucket 算例
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §5.10.1-5.10.2; Appendix A, printed pages 166-168,176-177, PDF pages 166-168,176-177

claims.zh_tw: NPWG／NPWA、NPRG／NPRA 分別描述寫入與讀取的建議大小及對齊，NOWS／NORS 描述最佳大小。這些 performance hints 不取代 atomic boundaries、命令硬限制或格式規則。
claims.en: NPWG/NPWA and NPRG/NPRA describe recommended write and read granularities and alignments; NOWS/NORS describe optimal sizes. These performance hints do not replace atomic boundaries, command hard limits, or format rules.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 對齊、granularity 與效能提示
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §5.2.2, printed pages 122-129, PDF pages 122-129

claims.zh_tw: 每個 namespace 在 format 時選一種 metadata 傳輸機制：與 data 相連形成 extended LBA，或由 MPTR 指向 separate buffer。不能把 metadata 分拆到兩種機制；寫入時 metadata 必須與其 logical block 原子寫入。
claims.en: Formatting selects one metadata transfer mechanism per namespace: contiguous extended LBAs or a separate buffer addressed by MPTR. Metadata cannot be split between the mechanisms and must be written atomically with its associated logical block.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Metadata 傳輸與 PI 的位置
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.6; 5.2.3; 5.3, printed pages 22,129-131, PDF pages 22,129-131

claims.zh_tw: 16b Guard PI 共 8 bytes；32b 與 64b Guard PI 各 16 bytes。Application Tag 固定 16 bits，Storage/Reference Space 分別為 32、80、48 bits。32b／64b 格式限 logical block data size 至少 4 KiB。
claims.en: 16b Guard PI occupies eight bytes; 32b and 64b Guard PI each occupy 16 bytes. Application Tag is 16 bits, and Storage/Reference Space is respectively 32, 80, or 48 bits. The 32b/64b formats require logical block data size of at least 4 KiB.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 16／32／64b Guard 與 Qualified PI
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §5.3.1; 4.1.5.3, printed pages 97-102,130-138, PDF pages 97-102,130-138

claims.zh_tw: 32b Guard 使用 CRC-32C；64b Guard 使用 NVM Express 64b CRC，polynomial AD93D23594C93659h、全一 Init／XorOut、RefIn／RefOut=true。不能只用「CRC64」名稱選任意 polynomial。
claims.en: 32b Guard uses CRC-32C. 64b Guard uses the NVM Express 64b CRC with polynomial AD93D23594C93659h, all-ones Init/XorOut, and RefIn/RefOut=true. The label CRC64 alone does not select the correct polynomial.
claims.heading_zh_tw: CRC 參數、位元順序與已知向量
claims.heading_en: CRC parameters, bit order, and known vectors
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §5.3.1.1-5.3.1.3, printed pages 131-137, PDF pages 131-137

claims.zh_tw: Storage Tag 使用 Storage/Reference Space 的高 STS bits，其餘低 bits 是 Reference Tag。命令以 CDW2、CDW3、CDW14 的最多 80 bits 傳入實際或 expected tags；不同 Guard 格式使用不同子集合。
claims.en: Storage Tag occupies the high STS bits of Storage/Reference Space, with Reference Tag in the remaining low bits. Commands supply actual or expected tags in up to 80 bits across CDW2, CDW3, and CDW14; Guard formats use different subsets.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Storage／Reference Tag 的 Dword 封裝
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §5.3.1.4, printed pages 137-141, PDF pages 137-141

claims.zh_tw: PRACT 決定 PI 的傳遞、插入、移除或取代；PRCHK 的 Guard／Application／Reference bits 與獨立 STC 決定檢查要求。PRACT=1 且 MS>PI size 時，Read 仍傳回全部 metadata，不能一律解讀為刪除 PI。
claims.en: PRACT controls PI transfer, insertion, stripping, or replacement. PRCHK Guard/Application/Reference bits and independent STC control checking. With PRACT=1 and MS>PI size, Read still returns all metadata; PRACT=1 does not universally mean stripping PI.
claims.heading_zh_tw: PRACT 與 PRCHK／STC 的組合

claims.zh_tw: ANA 狀態會限制指定 Features 並改變 capacity 回報；Reservations 則依 reservation type、holder 與 registration 狀態決定各命令是否允許。這些共用 namespace 能力可適用於 PCIe 多 controller 情境。
claims.en: ANA state can restrict specified Features and alter capacity reporting. Reservations determine command permissions from reservation type, holder, and registration state. These shared-namespace capabilities can apply in PCIe multi-controller configurations.
claims.heading_zh_tw: ANA 與 Reservations 的 NVM 行為
claims.heading_en: NVM behavior under ANA and Reservations
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §5.1; 5.11, printed pages 119,172-173, PDF pages 119,172-173

claims.zh_tw: Track Send 啟用 LBA Migration Queue 後，controller 可聚合邏輯 block 修改或 deallocation 記錄。Entry 只在所報命令效果生效後發布，可早於該命令 CQE；queue entry 與 I/O completion 是不同時間點。
claims.en: After Track Send enables an LBA Migration Queue, the controller may aggregate logical-block modifications or deallocations. Entries are posted only after the reported effects take place and may precede the command CQE; queue entry and I/O completion are distinct milestones.
claims.heading_zh_tw: LBA Migration Queue 與變更追蹤
claims.heading_en: LBA Migration Queue and change tracking
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §4.1.8; 5.7, printed pages 113-114,162-164, PDF pages 113-114,162-164

claims.zh_tw: NVM Sanitize 命令採 Base 定義，背景 operation 的資料語意由 §5.12 補充。成功後 Block Erase 回值由廠商定義、Crypto Erase 回值不確定、Overwrite 依 pattern 規則；若 block 已 deallocate，則改用 deallocated-read 規則。
claims.en: The NVM Sanitize command follows Base, with §5.12 adding data semantics for the background operation. After success, Block Erase returns vendor-defined values, Crypto Erase indeterminate values, and Overwrite follows its pattern rules; deallocated blocks instead follow deallocated-read rules.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Sanitize 與 Media Verification 的 NVM 規則
claims.heading_en: NVM rules for Sanitize and Media Verification
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §4.1.7; 5.12, printed pages 113,173-175, PDF pages 113,173-175

claims.zh_tw: Key Per I/O 的 NVM 補充要求使用 key tag 的命令符合 KPIODAAG 的 LBA 起點對齊與長度 granularity；不符合時回 Invalid Field in Command。Capability、namespace enablement 與 key 管理是不同層次。
claims.en: The NVM Key Per I/O extension requires key-tagged commands to meet KPIODAAG starting-LBA alignment and length granularity; violations return Invalid Field in Command. Capability, namespace enablement, and key management are separate layers.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Key Per I/O 的 NVM 對齊約束
claims.heading_en: NVM alignment constraints for Key Per I/O
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §5.5; 4.1.5, printed pages 91-92,105,160, PDF pages 91-92,105,160

claims.zh_tw: NVM 的 Stream Write Size 以 logical blocks 表示；stream granularity length 是 SGS 乘依欄位換算後 SWS blocks。使用 Streams 時，host 宜依 SGS／SWS 的建議處理 write／deallocate，再協調 namespace hints。
claims.en: NVM Stream Write Size is expressed in logical blocks. Stream granularity length is SGS multiplied by the SWS value after reading the fields. When using Streams, hosts should follow SGS/SWS guidance for writes/deallocation and reconcile namespace hints.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Streams 的 NVM 單位與優先順序
claims.heading_en: NVM units and priorities for Streams
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §5.2.2.3; 5.13, printed pages 128-129,175, PDF pages 128-129,175

claims.zh_tw: Reference Exported NVM Subsystem Template 是選用的 memory-based 範本，限定一個 controller（ID 0h）及一個 namespace（ID 1h）。建立時必須設 TR=1；configuration state 只能以一筆命令設定一次，重複設定回 Command Sequence Error。
claims.en: The optional Reference Exported NVM Subsystem Template is memory-based and permits one controller (ID 0h) and one namespace (ID 1h). Creation requires TR=1. Configuration state is set once in one command; repeated setting returns Command Sequence Error.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Memory-based 資源匯出範本
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §5.4.1-5.4.1.1, printed pages 152-159, PDF pages 152-159

claims.zh_tw: Reference Exported NVM Subsystem State 保存目前 Feature values 與 controller state。CSATTR.CP=1 表示整段 Migration Receive 處理期間 controller 都處於 suspended；NVMECSS 以 dwords 指出可變 NVMECS 長度，內層 VER 固定為 1h。
claims.en: Reference Exported NVM Subsystem State stores current Feature values and controller state. CSATTR.CP=1 means the controller remained suspended throughout Migration Receive processing. NVMECSS gives the variable NVMECS length in dwords; the nested VER is fixed to 1h.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 匯出狀態的長度與一致性
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §5.4.1.2, printed pages 159-160, PDF pages 159-160

claims.zh_tw: 三份規格分別回答共通協定、傳輸方式與資料操作的問題。
claims.en: Figure 1, "NVMe Family of Specifications": Read by functional layer: Base supplies shared mechanisms, PCIe the local transport, and NVM logical-block command semantics.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §1.1, Figure 1, 文件頁 9, PDF 頁 9
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §1.1, Figure 1, printed pages 9, PDF pages 9

claims.zh_tw: LBA 是資料區塊的編號，換成 byte 位置還需要區塊大小。
claims.en: Figure 2, "Acronym definitions": LBA addresses a logical block, not a byte offset; converting to data bytes also requires LBADS from the selected format.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §1.5, Figure 2, 文件頁 11, PDF 頁 11
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §1.5, Figure 2, printed pages 11, PDF pages 11

claims.zh_tw: 融合的 Compare 與 Write 把比對結果當成是否更新的條件。
claims.en: Figure 3, "Supported Fused Operations": Compare must succeed before Write updates the same range. Two CQEs report comparison and write outcomes separately; fused atomicity limits still apply.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.3, Figure 3, 文件頁 14, PDF 頁 14
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.3, Figure 3, printed pages 14, PDF pages 14

claims.zh_tw: 原子性參數要先選控制器或 namespace 的值，再換算實際大小。
claims.en: Figure 4, "Atomicity Parameters for Single Atomicity Mode": Use NSABP to select controller or namespace parameters, then interpret the fields zero-based sizes and namespace zero-value inheritance. Raw zero does not universally mean one block.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.4, Figure 4, 文件頁 15-16, PDF 頁 15-16
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.4, Figure 4, printed pages 15-16, PDF pages 15-16

claims.zh_tw: 正常運作下的重疊寫入結果取決於原子大小與讀寫範圍。
claims.en: Figure 5, "AWUN/NAWUN Example Results": This table concerns observable overlapping-write results during normal operation. Compare write size with interpret the fields AWUN and find the read within atomic units.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.4, Figure 5, 文件頁 17, PDF 頁 17
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.4, Figure 5, printed pages 17, PDF pages 17

claims.zh_tw: 斷電結果表必須先有明確的寫入前資料與此次更新範圍。
claims.en: Figure 6, "AWUPF/NAWUPF Example Initial State of NVM": Record pre-failure media contents and the new write range. This initial state supplies the assumptions for the following failure-result table.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.4, Figure 6, 文件頁 18, PDF 頁 18
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.4, Figure 6, printed pages 18, PDF pages 18

claims.zh_tw: 斷電時的資料保證依寫入是否符合 power-fail 原子範圍而變化。
claims.en: Figure 7, "AWUPF/NAWUPF Example Final State of NVM": Separate old-data preservation within the power-fail atomic unit from possible torn writes above it. An unfinished write cannot be assumed to contain all-new data.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.4, Figure 7, 文件頁 18, PDF 頁 18
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.4, Figure 7, printed pages 18, PDF pages 18

claims.zh_tw: 寫入長度足夠小，仍可能因起點位置而跨越原子邊界。
claims.en: Figure 8, "Atomic Boundaries Example": Place boundaries at offset+k×boundary size on the LBA line. A write shorter than the atomic size can still cross a boundary because of its starting position.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.4, Figure 8, 文件頁 19, PDF 頁 19
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.4, Figure 8, printed pages 19, PDF pages 19

claims.zh_tw: Multiple 模式把較大寫入分成符合參數的原子子範圍。
claims.en: Figure 9, "Atomicity Parameter Differences for Multiple Atomicity Mode": Multiple mode aligns the applicable normal/power-fail sizes with both boundary sizes. Fused Compare-and-Write still follows Single mode.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.4, Figure 9, 文件頁 20, PDF 頁 20
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.4, Figure 9, printed pages 20, PDF pages 20

claims.zh_tw: 圖中的大命令 D 對應多個子範圍，方便比較兩種原子模式。
claims.en: Figure 10, "Multiple Atomicity Example": A/B/C require separate commands for the illustrated Single-mode guarantees. Multiple-mode D can cover them together, but guarantees remain per subrange, not one D-wide transaction.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.4, Figure 10, 文件頁 21, PDF 頁 21
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.4, Figure 10, printed pages 21, PDF pages 21

claims.zh_tw: PRACT 決定 PI 的處理方式，PRCHK 決定要進行哪些檢查。
claims.en: Figure 11, "Protection Information Field Definition": PRACT selects an action and PRCHK selects three checks. With PRACT=1, compare MS with PI size to determine stripping/insertion versus preservation of metadata size.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.5, Figure 11, 文件頁 21-22, PDF 頁 21-22
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.5, Figure 11, printed pages 21-22, PDF pages 21-22

claims.zh_tw: Storage Tag 是否存在，決定 STC 檢查要求是否有對象。
claims.en: Figure 12, "Storage Tag Check Definition": STC enables Storage Tag checking. When STS=0 there is no Storage Tag and the controller ignores STC.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.5, Figure 12, 文件頁 22, PDF 頁 22
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.1.5, Figure 12, printed pages 22, PDF pages 22

claims.zh_tw: Admin 命令支援表要同時看命令列與控制器種類。
claims.en: Figure 13, "NVM Command Set Admin Command Support": Get LBA Status 86h is optional for an I/O controller and prohibited for an Administrative controller.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.2.1, Figure 13, 文件頁 23, PDF 頁 23
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.2.1, Figure 13, printed pages 23, PDF pages 23

claims.zh_tw: I/O 命令清單區分必備操作與需要另查能力的操作。
claims.en: Figure 14, "I/O Controller – NVM Command Set I/O Command Support": Read/Write are mandatory. Compare, Verify, Copy, Write Zeroes, Write Uncorrectable, and other optional commands require their own capability checks; appearing in the table does not establish support.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.2.1, Figure 14, 文件頁 23, PDF 頁 23
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.2.1, Figure 14, printed pages 23, PDF pages 23

claims.zh_tw: Log 清單說明不同控制器可支援哪些紀錄。
claims.en: Figure 15, "NVM Command Set Log Page Support": 0Eh is optional for I/O controllers; 28h is optional for I/O and Administrative controllers. Check the log definition separately for scope.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.2.2, Figure 15, 文件頁 23, PDF 頁 23
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.2.2, Figure 15, printed pages 23, PDF pages 23

claims.zh_tw: Feature 支援程度與設定作用範圍是兩個不同資訊。
claims.en: Figure 16, "NVM Command Set Feature Support": Match each Feature support row to controller type. Performance Characteristics on an Administrative controller cannot have namespace scope.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.2.3, Figure 16, 文件頁 23-24, PDF 頁 23-24
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.2.3, Figure 16, printed pages 23-24, PDF pages 23-24

claims.zh_tw: Feature 更新是否記入事件紀錄，不等於 Feature 能不能使用。
claims.en: Figure 17, "NVM Command Set Feature Logged in Persistent Event Log Page Requirement": This table governs recording Feature updates in the Persistent Event Log. NR for 03h does not prohibit the Feature and is not another Feature support classification.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.2.3, Figure 17, 文件頁 24, PDF 頁 24
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §2.2.3, Figure 17, printed pages 24, PDF pages 24

claims.zh_tw: LBA 超出可定址範圍與容量不足有不同回覆。
claims.en: Figure 18, "Status Code – Generic Command Status Values": Generic status 80h is LBA Out of Range and 81h Capacity Exceeded. Retain SCT and check NSZE separately from NCAP/NUSE.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.1.2, Figure 18, 文件頁 25, PDF 頁 25
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.1.2, Figure 18, printed pages 25, PDF pages 25

claims.zh_tw: 命令專屬狀態要連同命令種類解釋。
claims.en: Figure 19, "Status Code – Command Specific Status Values": Use opcode and SCT=1 to select command-specific status. Copy format/overlap errors and Read PI errors have different applicability sets.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.1.2, Figure 19, 文件頁 25, PDF 頁 25
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.1.2, Figure 19, printed pages 25, PDF pages 25

claims.zh_tw: 完整性錯誤可能是資料不符或區塊配置狀態，不一定是媒體損壞。
claims.en: Figure 20, "Status Code – Media and Data Integrity Error Values": Media/Data Integrity status includes Compare miscomparison and deallocated/unwritten access errors. Investigate DULBE for the latter rather than immediately declaring bad media.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.1.2, Figure 20, 文件頁 26, PDF 頁 26
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.1.2, Figure 20, printed pages 26, PDF pages 26

claims.zh_tw: FDP 回覆把放置識別碼連到可寫入資源及其剩餘量。
claims.en: Figure 21, "Reclaim Unit Handle Status Descriptor": Use PID for Placement Handle/Reclaim Group, then interpret RUHID, estimated time remaining, and writable blocks. RUAMW is not a fixed nominal RU size.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.2.1.1, Figure 21, 文件頁 26, PDF 頁 26
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.2.1.1, Figure 21, printed pages 26, PDF pages 26

claims.zh_tw: 操作碼中的傳輸方向描述主機與控制器之間交換的資料。
claims.en: Figure 22, "Opcodes for NVM Commands": The low two opcode bits encode transfer direction; Copy transfers descriptors host-to-controller. Broadcast NSID is unavailable except for specifically noted commands.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3, Figure 22, 文件頁 27, PDF 頁 27
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3, Figure 22, printed pages 27, PDF pages 27

claims.zh_tw: Compare 的 MPTR 指向要一起比較的獨立 metadata。
claims.en: Figure 23, "Compare – Metadata Pointer": MPTR supplies the metadata location for a separate-metadata format. Check PSDT/metadata format first; it is not the user-data buffer.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.1, Figure 23, 文件頁 28, PDF 頁 28
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.1, Figure 23, printed pages 28, PDF pages 28

claims.zh_tw: Compare 的 DPTR 提供預期內容，供控制器與媒體資料比較。
claims.en: Figure 24, "Compare – Data Pointer": Here DPTR addresses host input: expected Compare data or new Write data. The common command format determines PRP/SGL interpretation.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.1, Figure 24, 文件頁 28, PDF 頁 28
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.1, Figure 24, printed pages 28, PDF pages 28

claims.zh_tw: Compare 的高位 tag 欄位要與 CDW14 合併才能形成完整預期值。
claims.en: Figure 25, "Compare – Command Dword 2 and Dword 3": Combine CDW2/3 upper tags with CDW14 lower tags, then split expected storage/reference fields by PI format and STS. Unused bits are ignored as specified by the format.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.1, Figure 25, 文件頁 28, PDF 頁 28
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.1, Figure 25, printed pages 28, PDF pages 28

claims.zh_tw: Compare 的 SLBA 指定比較範圍起點。
claims.en: Figure 26, "Compare – Command Dword 10 and Command Dword 11": SLBA is 64 bits: low 32 in CDW10, high 32 in CDW11. Check range-specific modes before using it as an address.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.1, Figure 26, 文件頁 28, PDF 頁 28
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.1, Figure 26, printed pages 28, PDF pages 28

claims.zh_tw: Compare 的長度與保護檢查選項放在同一個命令字中。
claims.en: Figure 27, "Compare – Command Dword 12": CDW12 combines behavior bits with zero-based NLB. Compare/Verify require PRACT=0, while Read/Write select PRACT by metadata format. FUA does not order other commands.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.1, Figure 27, 文件頁 28-29, PDF 頁 28-29
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.1, Figure 27, printed pages 28-29, PDF pages 28-29

claims.zh_tw: Compare 的 CDW13 在啟用命令擴充時承載擴充值。
claims.en: Figure 28, "Compare - Command Dword 13 if CETYPE is non-zero": With nonzero CETYPE, CDW13 low16 contains CEV. CETYPE=0 has a different or reserved layout; do not simultaneously encode DSM hints.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.1, Figure 28, 文件頁 29, PDF 頁 29
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.1, Figure 28, printed pages 29, PDF pages 29

claims.zh_tw: Compare 的 CDW14 是預期 tag 空間的低 32 bits。
claims.en: Figure 29, "Compare – Command Dword 14": CDW14 contains the low 32 bits of expected-tag space. It is not necessarily all Reference Tag: STS may consume some high bits.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.1, Figure 29, 文件頁 29, PDF 頁 29
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.1, Figure 29, printed pages 29, PDF pages 29

claims.zh_tw: Compare 的 Application Tag mask 決定哪些位元參與比對。
claims.en: Figure 30, "Compare – Command Dword 15": CDW15 high16 is the Application Tag mask and low16 the expected tag. A zero mask bit excludes comparison rather than requiring a zero tag bit.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.1, Figure 30, 文件頁 29, PDF 頁 29
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.1, Figure 30, printed pages 29, PDF pages 29

claims.zh_tw: Compare 的設定錯誤與實際資料比對失敗需要分開理解。
claims.en: Figure 31, "Compare – Command Specific Status Values": Compare SC together with SCT and this command’s applicable entries. Invalid Protection Information concerns settings/initial values incompatible with the format, distinct from a Guard Check Error. Apply only entries listed for the command.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.1, Figure 31, 文件頁 30, PDF 頁 30
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.1, Figure 31, printed pages 30, PDF pages 30

claims.zh_tw: Copy 的 DPTR 指向來源範圍描述子。
claims.en: Figure 32, "Copy – Data Pointer": DPTR addresses descriptors rather than user data to copy or deallocate. Compute buffer length from descriptor size and the range count after reading the fields.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 32, 文件頁 30, PDF 頁 30
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 32, printed pages 30, PDF pages 30

claims.zh_tw: Copy 命令本身的高位 tag 描述目的端資料保護。
claims.en: Figure 33, "Copy – Command Dword 2 and Dword 3": Upper/lower tag fields encode write-side Storage and initial Reference Tags. For Copy these command fields belong to the destination; source expectations are in descriptors.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 33, 文件頁 30, PDF 頁 30
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 33, printed pages 30, PDF pages 30

claims.zh_tw: Copy 的 SDLBA 是串接所有來源範圍後的目的起點。
claims.en: Figure 34, "Copy – Command Dword 10 and Command Dword 11": SDLBA identifies the first destination block; subsequent sources concatenate in descriptor order rather than restarting the destination for each range.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 34, 文件頁 30, PDF 頁 30
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 34, printed pages 30, PDF pages 30

claims.zh_tw: Copy 分別指定讀端與寫端 PI 行為，並選擇描述子格式。
claims.en: Figure 35, "Copy – Command Dword 12": Copy CDW12 separates read/write PI, descriptor format, and zero-based range count. STCRS is defined in Figure 127; this figure’s reference to Figure 115 is misplaced.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 35, 文件頁 30-31, PDF 頁 30-31
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 35, printed pages 30-31, PDF pages 30-31

claims.zh_tw: Copy 的 CDW13 分別容納 Directive 資訊與命令擴充資訊。
claims.en: Figure 36, "Copy – Command Dword 13": CDW13 high16 carries Directive Specific and low16 carries CEV according to CETYPE. Directive and command extension are separate fields.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 36, 文件頁 31, PDF 頁 31
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 36, printed pages 31, PDF pages 31

claims.zh_tw: Copy 的 CDW14 補齊目的端 tag 的低位元。
claims.en: Figure 37, "Copy – Command Dword 14": CDW14 supplies the low 32 bits of write tags. Split the space according to STS rather than discarding Storage Tag high bits.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 37, 文件頁 31, PDF 頁 31
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 37, printed pages 31, PDF pages 31

claims.zh_tw: Copy 的 LBAT 和 LBATM 描述目的端 Application Tag。
claims.en: Figure 38, "Copy – Command Dword 15": Application Tag mask/tag occupy CDW15 high16/low16. Copy uses these for the destination write, with separate expected fields for sources.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 38, 文件頁 32, PDF 頁 32
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 38, printed pages 32, PDF pages 32

claims.zh_tw: Copy 描述子格式決定來源 namespace 與 PI 資訊如何表示。
claims.en: Figure 39, "Copy – Copy Descriptor Formats": Formats 0h/2h pair with eight-byte PI and 1h/3h with 16-byte PI; 2h/3h contain SNSID. Format 4h refers to Memory Copy in another command set; this NVM document does not provide its complete descriptor layout.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 39, 文件頁 32, PDF 頁 32
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 39, printed pages 32, PDF pages 32

claims.zh_tw: Format 0h 與 2h 的來源項目使用相應的較短 tag 表示。
claims.en: Figure 40, "Copy – Source Range Entries Copy Descriptor Format 0h and Format 2h": Formats 0h/2h use 32-byte source entries. SNSID/FCO locations are reserved in 0h and usable in 2h. Add one to NLB before accumulating destination length.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 40, 文件頁 33-34, PDF 頁 33-34
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 40, printed pages 33-34, PDF pages 33-34

claims.zh_tw: Format 1h 與 3h 為較大的 tag 空間提供高、低欄位。
claims.en: Figure 41, "Copy – Source Range Entries Copy Descriptor Format 1h and Format 3h": Formats 1h/3h use 40-byte source entries with larger tag fields for 16-byte PI. Format 3h carries SNSID/FCO; a 32-byte parsing stride is incorrect.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 41, 文件頁 35-36, PDF 頁 35-36
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 41, printed pages 35-36, PDF pages 35-36

claims.zh_tw: 多個來源範圍按描述子順序連續寫入目的範圍。
claims.en: Figure 42, "Source LBA and Destination LBA Relationship Example": Sum the source lengths after reading the fields in descriptor order to form the contiguous destination. The diagram sums block counts, not raw NLB values missing one block per range.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 42, 文件頁 38, PDF 頁 38
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.2, Figure 42, printed pages 38, PDF pages 38

claims.zh_tw: Copy 失敗原因可以來自範圍、資源或快速複製條件。

claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.3, Figure 46, 文件頁 44-45, PDF 頁 44-45

claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.4, Figure 51, printed pages 49, PDF pages 49

claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §3.3.5, Figure 61, 文件頁 52, PDF 頁 52

claims.zh_tw: 版本描述子把主、次與修訂版本分開編碼。

claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §4.1.5.8, Figure 132, 文件頁 108, PDF 頁 108

claims.en: Figure 133, "Namespace Granularity Descriptor": NSG/NCG report preferred allocation granularity in bytes. Zero means unreported, not a divisor or a requirement for zero namespace size.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §4.1.5.8, Figure 133, 文件頁 108, PDF 頁 108

claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §4.1.6.4, Figure 134, printed pages 112-113, PDF pages 112-113

claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §4.2.1, Figure 138, 文件頁 114-115, PDF 頁 114-115

claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §4.2.1, Figure 139, 文件頁 116-117, PDF 頁 116-117

claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §4.2.1, Figure 140, 文件頁 117-118, PDF 頁 117-118

claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §5.2.1, Figure 143, 文件頁 121, PDF 頁 121

claims.en: Figure 144, "Example Get LBA Status Descriptors for LBA Range Descriptor 1": A log range can yield different numbers of detailed Get LBA Status descriptors. Use actual NLSD, NLB, and CMPC to determine whether follow-up is needed.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-NVM-CS-1.3, Rev. 1.3, §5.2.1, Figure 144, 文件頁 121-122, PDF 頁 121-122

Its Check=11199E506128D175h is the 64-bit reversal of the conventional LSB-first register result AE8B14860A799888h. Cross-check representation using Figure 163 vectors.

claims.zh_tw: 與命令集無關的 Identify Namespace 提供共享、屬性與路徑相關資訊。
claims.en: Figure 346, "Identify – I/O Command Set Independent Identify Namespace Data Structure": CNS08h provides command-set-independent namespace attributes and combines with NVM CNS00h/05h. No single structure establishes every capability.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.14.2.8, Figure 346, printed pages 391-394, PDF pages 417-420

claims.zh_tw: Sanitize 的 SANACT 決定方法，其他參數依方法才有意義。
claims.en: Figure 451, "Sanitize – Command Dword 10": Subsystem Sanitize CDW10 separates method from modifiers. NVM §4.1.7 uses this Base command format.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.26, Figure 451, 文件頁 450-451, PDF 頁 476-477
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.26, Figure 451, printed pages 450-451, PDF pages 476-477

claims.zh_tw: OVRPAT 指定 Overwrite 使用的 32-bit pattern。
claims.en: Figure 452, "Sanitize – Command Dword 11": CDW11 OVRPAT is the Overwrite pattern. Not every SANACT uses it, and it does not define Crypto Erase read values.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.26, Figure 452, 文件頁 451, PDF 頁 477
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.26, Figure 452, printed pages 451, PDF pages 477

claims.zh_tw: Host Behavior Support 告知控制器主機能處理哪些延伸行為。
claims.en: Figure 491, "Host Behavior Support – Data Structure": Host Behavior Support CFD2E/CFD3E declare host acceptance of Copy formats2h/3h. Controller CDF support and host enablement are separate gates.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.15, Figure 491, printed pages 476-477, PDF pages 502-503

claims.zh_tw: Track Send 的管理操作由 MO 與操作專屬參數一起決定。
claims.en: Figure 561, "Track Send – Command Dword 10": Track Send CDW10 selects a management operation before MOS is interpreted. Log User Data Changes tracks changes to NVM data.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.32, Figure 561, 文件頁 523, PDF 頁 549
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.32, Figure 561, printed pages 523, PDF pages 549

claims.zh_tw: LACT 選擇使用者資料變更紀錄的動作。
claims.en: Figure 562, "Log User Data Changes – Management Operation Specific Field": LACT controls starting/stopping user-data change logging and must be combined with CDQID for a created LBA Migration Queue.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.32.1.1, Figure 562, 文件頁 523, PDF 頁 549
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.32.1.1, Figure 562, printed pages 523, PDF pages 549

claims.zh_tw: CDQID 把變更追蹤操作連到指定的 Controller Data Queue。
claims.en: Figure 563, "Log User Data Changes – Command Dword 11": CDQID identifies the controller data queue, not NSID or SQID, selecting the destination for change records.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.32.1.1, Figure 563, 文件頁 523, PDF 頁 549
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.32.1.1, Figure 563, printed pages 523, PDF pages 549

claims.zh_tw: Streams 參數分別描述寫入大小與配置粒度。
claims.en: Figure 712, "Streams Directive – Return Parameters Data Structure": SWS/SGS in Streams Return Parameters describe write size and granularity. NVM §5.13 defines the command-set unit of SWS as logical blocks.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.9.3.1.1, Figure 712, printed pages 624-625, PDF pages 650-651

claims.zh_tw: Boot Partitions 是選用功能；支援時有兩個等大的 partition，ID 為 0h、1h。Host 可在未建立 queues、未啟用 controller 時透過 properties 讀取。
claims.en: Boot Partitions are optional; support provides two equally sized partitions with IDs 0h and 1h. A host can read through properties without creating queues or enabling the controller.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 兩個 Boot Partitions
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.3, 文件頁 586, PDF 頁 612
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.3, printed pages 586, PDF pages 612

claims.zh_tw: Host 先檢查 CAP.BPS、BPINFO 的 active ID/size，再配置連續 buffer 與 BPMBL，確認沒有讀取進行中後寫入 BPRSEL。BRS=01b 表示傳輸中，10b 表示成功，11b 表示錯誤；讀取中不得 reset、shutdown 或改動 transport-specific properties。
claims.en: The host checks CAP.BPS and the active ID/size in BPINFO, allocates a contiguous buffer and programs BPMBL, then writes BPRSEL only when no read is active. BRS=01b means transfer in progress, 10b success, and 11b error; reset, shutdown, and changes to transport-specific properties are prohibited during the read.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Property 讀取與 BRS
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.3.1, printed pages 586-587, PDF pages 612-613

claims.zh_tw: LID 15h 以 CDW10.LSP 的 BPID 選 partition，回傳 16-byte header 與其後的資料；BPSZ 以 128 KiB 計。此 log 讀取不改變 BPINFO、BPRSEL 或 BPMBL properties。
claims.en: LID 15h selects a partition through BPID in CDW10.LSP and returns a 16-byte header followed by data; BPSZ is measured in 128 KiB units. Reading this log does not modify the BPINFO, BPRSEL, or BPMBL properties.
claims.heading_zh_tw: LID 15h 的另一條讀取路徑
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.21, printed pages 283-284, PDF pages 309-310

claims.zh_tw: Boot image 從開頭依序用 Firmware Image Download 傳送；將目標解鎖後，以 Firmware Commit CA=110b 寫入 BPID 指定的 partition。Host 可讀回驗證，再以 CA=111b 更新 active ID，最後重新上鎖。更新中斷可能留下新舊混合內容，因此宜先驗證再設為 active。
claims.en: A boot image is downloaded in order from its beginning using Firmware Image Download. After unlocking the target, Firmware Commit CA=110b writes the partition selected by BPID. The host may read it back, use CA=111b to change the active ID, and relock it. An interrupted update can leave mixed old/new contents, so verification before activation is recommended.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 下載、寫入、驗證、切換
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.3.2, printed pages 587-588, PDF pages 613-614

claims.zh_tw: Host 不宜在寫入 Boot Partition 時同時讀取，也不宜重疊 firmware/boot image 更新序列。單一序列宜使用同一 controller 或 Management Endpoint；跨端點提交可能使 Commit 以 Invalid Firmware Image 結束。
claims.en: The host should avoid reading a Boot Partition while it is being written and should avoid overlapping firmware/boot-image update sequences. A single sequence should use the same controller or Management Endpoint; crossing endpoints may cause Commit to end with Invalid Firmware Image.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 更新序列的邊界
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.3.2, 文件頁 588, PDF 頁 614
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.3.2, printed pages 588, PDF pages 614

claims.zh_tw: BPCAP 回報 Set Features 與 RPMB Boot 保護能力。只有 Set Features 機制或 RPMB 尚未啟用時由 FID 85h 控制；RPMB 保護啟用後由 RPMB 控制。同一時刻只有一套機制控制狀態，共享 partition 的所有 controllers 都須執行其保護。
claims.en: BPCAP reports Set Features and RPMB boot-protection capabilities. FID 85h controls protection when it is the only mechanism or RPMB protection is not enabled; enabled RPMB protection takes control. Only one mechanism owns the state at a time, and all controllers sharing a partition enforce its protection.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 保護能力與控制權
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.3.3, printed pages 588-589, PDF pages 614-615

claims.zh_tw: BP0WPS 位於 CDW11[2:0]，BP1WPS 位於 [5:3]。000b 僅用於 Set 的不改變請求；001b/010b/011b 分別為 unlocked/locked/locked until power cycle；100b 由 Get 回報 RPMB 控制，不能作為 Set 值。此 Feature 不可 save，power cycle 後預設 locked。
claims.en: BP0WPS occupies CDW11[2:0] and BP1WPS [5:3]. Value 000b is a Set-only no-change request; 001b/010b/011b mean unlocked/locked/locked until power cycle. Get reports 100b for RPMB ownership, but it is not a valid Set value. This Feature is not saveable and defaults to locked after a power cycle.
claims.heading_zh_tw: FID 85h 逐欄判讀
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.39, printed pages 513-514, PDF pages 539-540

claims.zh_tw: Set Features 的 unlocked 狀態跨 Controller Level Reset 保留，但 power cycle 後回到 locked；目前為 locked-until-power-cycle 時，Set Features 變更要求會以 Feature Not Changeable 結束；power cycle 後回到 locked，仍需明確解鎖才能寫入。RPMB 保護啟用後，unlocked 遇 power cycle 或 Controller Level Reset 會回到 locked，且啟用本身不可撤回。
claims.en: Set Features unlocked state survives a Controller Level Reset but returns to locked after a power cycle; a Set Features change to locked-until-power-cycle returns Feature Not Changeable; a power cycle returns it to locked, so writing still requires an explicit unlock. With RPMB protection enabled, either a power cycle or Controller Level Reset relocks an unlocked partition, and enabling protection is irreversible.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 兩套保護的 reset 差異
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.3.3.1-8.1.3.3.3, printed pages 589-594, PDF pages 615-620

claims.zh_tw: 嘗試修改 locked-until-power-cycle 或 RPMB 控制中的狀態，FID 85h 以 Feature Not Changeable 拒絕。Multi-domain subsystem 中共享的 partition 不允許 locked-until-power-cycle。兩套機制並存時，只要任一 partition 在該狀態，就不得啟用 RPMB Boot 保護來繞過它。
claims.en: FID 85h rejects changes to locked-until-power-cycle or RPMB-owned states with Feature Not Changeable. A shared partition in a multi-domain subsystem cannot use locked-until-power-cycle. When both mechanisms exist, RPMB boot protection cannot be enabled while either partition is in that state to bypass it.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 保護狀態的拒絕條件

claims.zh_tw: Boot Partition log 的參數用 BPID 選要讀的分割區。
claims.en: Figure 279, "Boot Partition Log Specific Parameter Field": LID 15h uses CDW10 bit 8 as BPID and reserves other LSP bits; that same bit means CTHID for 07h.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.21, Figure 279, 文件頁 283, PDF 頁 309
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.21, Figure 279, printed pages 283, PDF pages 309

claims.zh_tw: Boot Partition log 先回報 header，再提供分割區資料。
claims.en: Figure 280, "Boot Partition Log Page": Header bytes are 0–15; BPINFO occupies 4–7 with ABPID at bit 31 and BPSZ at bits 14:0. BPD begins at byte 16 and is BPSZ×128 KiB long.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.21, Figure 280, 文件頁 284, PDF 頁 310
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.21, Figure 280, printed pages 284, PDF pages 310

claims.zh_tw: Boot Partition Write Protection Config 分別設定兩個分割區的保護狀態。
claims.en: Figure 542, "Boot Partition Write Protection Config - Command Dword 11": The two three-bit state fields are set independently. 000b only requests no change in Set; Get returns actual state and uses 100b only to report RPMB ownership.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.30.1.39, Figure 542, printed pages 513-514, PDF pages 539-540

claims.zh_tw: Boot Partition 圖連起裝置分割區與主機接收 buffer。
claims.en: Figure 679, "Boot Partition Overview": Separate the two equal Boot Partitions from this read's host buffer. Active ID selects the boot image, not a restriction to reading only the active partition.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.3.1, Figure 679, 文件頁 587, PDF 頁 613
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.3.1, Figure 679, printed pages 587, PDF pages 613

claims.zh_tw: Set Features 保護狀態圖用狀態與轉移說明何時能解除鎖定。
claims.en: Figure 680, "Set Features Boot Partition Write Protection State Machine Model": Set Features switches unlocked/locked and can move either to locked-until-power-cycle; a power cycle returns to locked. There is no ordinary Set-unlock edge from locked-until-power-cycle.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.3.3.1, Figure 680, 文件頁 589, PDF 頁 615
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.3.3.1, Figure 680, printed pages 589, PDF pages 615

claims.zh_tw: Set Features 保護狀態定義補上 reset 與斷電的影響。
claims.en: Figure 681, "Set Features Boot Partition Write Protection State Definitions": Compare all three states: controller reset preserves them, while power cycle changes unlocked and until-power-cycle to locked.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.3.3.1, Figure 681, 文件頁 590, PDF 頁 616
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.3.3.1, Figure 681, printed pages 590, PDF pages 616

claims.zh_tw: RPMB 保護狀態圖另外描述認證設定的啟用與鎖定。
claims.en: Figure 682, "RPMB Boot Partition Write Protection State Machine Model": Before and after RPMB enablement are different regions; once enabled, authenticated configuration writes unlock/lock and resets return to locked.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.3.3.2, Figure 682, 文件頁 591, PDF 頁 617
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.3.3.2, Figure 682, printed pages 591, PDF pages 617

claims.zh_tw: RPMB 保護狀態定義說明其保存及控制方式。
claims.en: Figure 683, "RPMB Boot Partition Write Protection State Definitions": For RPMB-only protection before enablement, unlocked can persist; once enabled, unlocked does not survive reset/power cycle. Dual-mechanism support also requires Figure 684's defaults and ownership rules.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.3.3.2, Figure 683, 文件頁 591, PDF 頁 617
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.3.3.2, Figure 683, printed pages 591, PDF pages 617

claims.zh_tw: 整體 Boot 保護模型說明 Set Features 與 RPMB 狀態如何共同決定結果。
claims.en: Figure 684, "Boot Partition Write Protection State Machine Model": Track states in the Set Features region, then transfer through the enable gate to RPMB; until-power-cycle cannot be bypassed through RPMB enablement.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.3.3.3, Figure 684, 文件頁 593, PDF 頁 619
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.3.3.3, Figure 684, printed pages 593, PDF pages 619

claims.zh_tw: CAP 描述控制器能力，主機設定必須落在其支援範圍。
claims.en: Figure 36, "Offset 0h: CAP - Controller Capabilities": Check BPS before using Boot properties; Boot support does not imply an enabled controller.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.1.4.1, Figure 36, 文件頁 55-58, PDF 頁 81-84
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.1.4.1, Figure 36, printed pages 55-58, PDF pages 81-84

claims.zh_tw: BPINFO 把啟用分割區、讀取狀態與大小放在一起回報。
claims.en: Figure 49, "Offset 40h: BPINFO - Boot Partition Information": ABPID identifies the active partition, BPSZ uses 128 KiB units, and BRS distinguishes no request/in progress/success/error with 00b/01b/10b/11b.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.1.4.13, Figure 49, 文件頁 69, PDF 頁 95
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.1.4.13, Figure 49, printed pages 69, PDF pages 95

claims.zh_tw: BPRSEL 指定 Boot Partition 讀取的目標、起点與長度。
claims.en: Figure 50, "Offset 44h: BPRSEL - Boot Partition Read Select": BPRSEL bit 31 is BPID, bit 30 is reserved, [29:10] is BPROF in 4 KiB units, and [9:0] is BPRSZ in 4 KiB units; writing initiates a read.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.1.4.14, Figure 50, 文件頁 69-70, PDF 頁 95-96
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.1.4.14, Figure 50, printed pages 69-70, PDF pages 95-96

claims.zh_tw: BPMBL 提供接收 Boot Partition 資料的主機記憶體位置。
claims.en: Figure 51, "Offset 48h: BPMBL - Boot Partition Memory Buffer Location": BPMBL[63:12] provides the Boot Memory Buffer base address; the low 12 bits are reserved. Establish a contiguous, aligned host buffer first.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.1.4.15, Figure 51, 文件頁 70, PDF 頁 96
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §3.1.4.15, Figure 51, printed pages 70, PDF pages 96

claims.zh_tw: Firmware Commit 的 CA 選動作，FS 或 BPID 指相關目標。
claims.en: Figure 187, "Firmware Commit - Command Dword 10": For Boot, use BPID and CA=110b/111b: the former replaces partition contents and the latter changes the active ID. They are separate actions.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.9, Figure 187, 文件頁 203, PDF 頁 229
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.9, Figure 187, printed pages 203, PDF pages 229

claims.zh_tw: Firmware Commit 回覆中的旗標描述特定更新偵測結果。
claims.en: Figure 188, "Firmware Commit - Completion Queue Entry Dword 0": MUD supplies completion evidence for overlapping updates; the single-controller/endpoint image-sequence boundary still applies.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.9.1, Figure 188, 文件頁 204, PDF 頁 230
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.9.1, Figure 188, printed pages 204, PDF pages 230

claims.zh_tw: Firmware Commit 狀態區分映像、slot 與需要重設等條件。
claims.en: Figure 189, "Firmware Commit - Command Specific Status Values": Boot Partition Write Prohibited points to protection state; Invalid Firmware Image points to image/sequence validation. Classify status before choosing a retry step.
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.9.1, Figure 189, printed pages 204-205, PDF pages 230-231

claims.zh_tw: Firmware Image Download 的 DPTR 指向此次傳入的映像區段。
claims.en: Figure 190, "Firmware Image Download - Data Pointer": Download DPTR identifies the host buffer for this image portion, not the destination Boot Partition address.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.10, Figure 190, 文件頁 205, PDF 頁 231
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.10, Figure 190, printed pages 205, PDF pages 231

claims.zh_tw: Firmware Download 的 NUMD 以 Dwords 且從零起算表示長度。
claims.en: Figure 191, "Firmware Image Download - Command Dword 10": NUMD is the portion's zero-based dword count: 512 bytes encodes as 127, with Download alignment/granularity requirements checked separately.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.10, Figure 191, 文件頁 205, PDF 頁 231
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.10, Figure 191, printed pages 205, PDF pages 231

claims.zh_tw: Firmware Download 的 OFST 指定映像中的 Dword 偏移。
claims.en: Figure 192, "Firmware Image Download - Command Dword 11": OFST is an image offset in dwords. Boot images are sent in order from the beginning; do not borrow other ordering assumptions for ordinary firmware portions.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.10, Figure 192, 文件頁 206, PDF 頁 232
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.10, Figure 192, printed pages 206, PDF pages 232

claims.zh_tw: Overlapping Range 狀態指出傳入的映像區段發生不允許的重疊。
claims.en: Figure 193, "Firmware Image Download - Command Specific Status Values": Overlapping Range reports overlapping download portions; preserve each offset and length to reconstruct the offending range.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.10, Figure 193, 文件頁 206, PDF 頁 232
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.10, Figure 193, printed pages 206, PDF pages 232

claims.zh_tw: Get Features 的 FID 選功能，SEL 選要查目前值、預設值等資訊。
claims.en: Figure 198, "Get Features - Command Dword 10": Get Features uses FID for the feature and SEL for current/default/saved/capabilities. Do not confuse values for FID 85h/17h with their capabilities.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12, Figure 198, 文件頁 209-210, PDF 頁 235-236
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12, Figure 198, printed pages 209-210, PDF pages 235-236

claims.zh_tw: Get Features 的 UIDX 在使用 UUID 選擇時提供索引。
claims.en: Figure 199, "Get Features - Command Dword 14": The CDW14 UUID Index belongs to the common Feature interface; these standard FIDs do not call for invented vendor-UUID mappings.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12, Figure 199, 文件頁 210, PDF 頁 236
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.12, Figure 199, printed pages 210, PDF pages 236

claims.zh_tw: Get Log Page 的 DPTR 指向主機接收 log 資料的空間。
claims.en: Figure 203, "Get Log Page - Data Pointer": Get Log Page's data pointer identifies a receive buffer large enough for the encoded NUMD request.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13, Figure 203, 文件頁 213, PDF 頁 239
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13, Figure 203, printed pages 213, PDF pages 239

claims.zh_tw: Get Log Page 的 CDW10 選擇 log、低位長度及相關控制參數。
claims.en: Figure 204, "Get Log Page - Command Dword 10": CDW10[7:0]=LID, [14:8]=LSP, [15]=RAE, and [31:16]=NUMDL. LID determines whether LSP means Boot BPID or Telemetry capture controls.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13, Figure 204, 文件頁 213, PDF 頁 239

claims.en: Figure 205, "Get Log Page - Command Dword 11": NUMDU and NUMDL form the zero-based dword count; LSI is a separate log-specific selector, not LSP.
claims.citation_zh_tw: 來源：NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13, Figure 205, 文件頁 214, PDF 頁 240

claims.zh_tw: RPMB Device Configuration Block 保存 Boot 保護的設定資訊。
claims.en: Figure 756, "RPMB Device Configuration Block Data Structure": The Device Configuration Block separates protection enablement from each partition's lock control; once enabled, writes attempting to disable RPMB Boot protection are rejected.

claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.24.2.1, Figure 761, printed pages 695-696, PDF pages 721-722

claims.zh_tw: Telemetry 的 header 為 block 0，每個 block 是 512 bytes；所有 Data Areas 都從 block 1 起算。Area 2/3/4 是更大的累積集合，不是接在 Area 1 後的獨立區塊。Last Block 是包含在內的最後 block 編號；payload 格式與大小由廠商定義。
claims.en: Telemetry uses block 0 for its header and 512-byte blocks. Every Data Area begins at block 1. Areas 2/3/4 are larger cumulative sets, not disjoint regions placed after Area 1. Last Block is an inclusive block number; payload format and size are vendor-defined.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Header 與累積式 Data Areas

claims.zh_tw: LID 07h 的 CTHID 是 CDW10 bit 8；設為 1 要求新 capture，0 不更新該 snapshot。MCDA 是 bits 11:9，只有 MCDAS=1 且 CTHID=1 時適用；001b 至 100b 分別要求建立至 Area 1 至 Area 4，000b 由 controller 決定。MCDAS 來自 Supported Log Pages 的 LID Specific Parameter。
claims.en: CTHID for LID 07h is CDW10 bit 8: one requests a new capture and zero does not update that snapshot. MCDA occupies bits 11:9 and applies only when MCDAS=1 and CTHID=1; 001b through 100b request creation through Areas 1 through 4, while 000b lets the controller decide. MCDAS comes from the LID Specific Parameter in Supported Log Pages.
claims.heading_zh_tw: CTHID 與 MCDA
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.8, printed pages 232-235, PDF pages 258-261

claims.zh_tw: Controller 以 LPA.TS 宣告 Telemetry 支援，以 LPA.DA4S 宣告 Area 4；Host 以 FID 16h Host Behavior Support 的 ETDAS=1 宣告支援。DA4S 與 ETDAS 一起決定 Area 4 是否適用；建立 Area 4 時也須建立有資料的 Area 3。
claims.en: The controller advertises Telemetry through LPA.TS and Area 4 through LPA.DA4S; the host advertises support with ETDAS=1 in FID 16h Host Behavior Support. DA4S and ETDAS together determine Area 4 applicability; creating Area 4 also requires a populated Area 3.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Area 4 的雙方支援條件
claims.heading_en: Both sides of Data Area 4 support
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.30; 5.2.30.1.15, printed pages 476,733-734, PDF pages 502,759-760

claims.zh_tw: 讀取 LID 07h/08h 時，offset 與 transfer length 必須是 512 bytes 的倍數，否則回報 Invalid Field in Command。Controller 回傳被要求的 blocks，但超過適用最後 Data Area 邊界的資料不具規格定義的內容。
claims.en: For LID 07h/08h, offset and transfer length must be multiples of 512 bytes or the command reports Invalid Field in Command. The controller returns requested blocks, but data beyond the applicable final Data Area boundary has undefined contents.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Offset、長度與保留範圍
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.8-5.2.13.1.9, printed pages 232-237, PDF pages 258-263

claims.zh_tw: Host 讀 header 記住 generation，以 RAE=1 分段收集，再重讀 header 比對 generation；不同就重新讀取。讀 08h 還需確認 TCDA 未被其他讀取者清除；完成後用 RAE=0 讀任一部分來 acknowledgement。Generation 是 8-bit，FFh 後回到 0h。
claims.en: The host records the header generation, collects chunks with RAE=1, and rereads the header; a changed generation calls for rereading. For 08h it also checks that another reader has not cleared TCDA, then acknowledges completion by reading any portion with RAE=0. Generation is eight bits and wraps from FFh to 0h.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 一致性與完成讀取
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §8.1.30, printed pages 734-735, PDF pages 760-761

claims.zh_tw: Base 2.4 的 TCDA=0 表示自上次成功 RAE=0 讀取後沒有更新。第一次 capture 前 header 可讀；capture 過後，即使 TCDA=0，仍回傳 header 與目前保存的 internal state。不能把舊版『0 表示只有 header』的解讀沿用至 2.4。
claims.en: In Base 2.4, TCDA=0 means no update since the last successful RAE=0 read. The header is readable before the first capture; after a capture, both the header and current saved internal state are returned even with TCDA=0. The older interpretation that zero means header-only must not be carried into 2.4.
claims.heading_zh_tw: 2.4 的 TCDA=0
claims.citation_en: Source: NVME-BASE-2.4, Rev. 2.4, §5.2.13.1.9, printed pages 237, PDF pages 263

claims.zh_tw: 07h 的 snapshot 不變，直到新的 CTHID=1、Firmware Commit 或 power-on reset。08h Areas 1–3 跨所有 resets 保留，Area 4 可跨 Controller Level Resets 保留；08h 的 TCDA、TCDGN 跨 power cycles 與 resets 保留。
claims.en: The 07h snapshot stays unchanged until another CTHID=1 request, Firmware Commit, or power-on reset. For 08h, Areas 1–3 persist across all resets and Area 4 may persist across Controller Level Resets; TCDA and TCDGN persist across power cycles and resets.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Snapshot 的保留條件

claims.zh_tw: Host 以 FID 0Bh 的 TLN bit 10 啟用 Telemetry Log Notices；controller 以 Notice 類型的 Telemetry Log Changed AER 通知，也可由 07h/08h 的 TCDA 得知資料更新。
claims.en: The host enables Telemetry Log Notices with TLN bit 10 of FID 0Bh. The controller reports a Notice-type Telemetry Log Changed AER; TCDA in 07h/08h also exposes an update.
claims.heading_zh_tw: Telemetry Notice 的啟用

claims.zh_tw: Controller-Initiated Telemetry 由控制器建立並回報可讀取狀態。
